jobs.description:
RESPONSABILITÉS :

Que ferez-vous à nos côtés ?
Rattaché au Directeur du Développement des activités Cloud, nous recherchons un Ingénieur d'Affaires Cloud et Services Managés :
- Identifier et prospecter de nouveaux clients potentiels, développer des opportunités autour des activités Cloud sur des comptes cibles
- Assurer la fidélisation d'un portefeuille client (upselling, cross-selling, mise en place d'actions, anticipation des attentes...)
- Comprendre les besoins spécifiques des clients et proposer des solutions informatiques adaptées à leurs exigences.
- Assurer la prise de commandes, par des actions en amont avec les équipes de business développement, jusqu'aux phases de closing
- Assurer un suivi régulier avec les clients pour garantir leur satisfaction et favoriser des relations à long terme.
- Collaborer avec les équipes internes pour garantir la livraison efficace des solutions vendues et assurer une intégration réussie
- Assurer un reporting clair et fiable vers la direction commerciale.

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ :

Qui êtes-vous ?
Vous possédez une expérience dans la vente de services IT chez un Cloud Services Provider, et/ou un Managed Security Services Provider, et vous savez promouvoir des offres de Cloud Hybride (Mutualisé, dédié, Hypersacler).
La fidélisation d'un portefeuille client n'a pas de secret pour vous : sur votre territoire, composé essentiellement d'ETI et de Grands Comptes, vous êtes en mesure d'identifier des opportunités et de développer rapidement un pipe commercial autour de sujets orientés autour du Cloud et des Services Managés.
Vous avez l'habitude de travailler avec les avant-vente et les SDM. jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn AI ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.



You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re someone who loves helping customers build workflows that solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts ensuring your customers know how to deliver outcomes with Notion

 - Contribute directly to NRR with predictable renewal and expansion pipeline and proactive product adoption for your book of business

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultants on strategy for expansion and renewal for shared accounts, including owning the commercial opportunity for flat and at-risk renewals

 - Define and maintain mutual success plans that proactively guide customers through their AI Transformation and demonstrate ROI to executive-level stakeholders with periodic business reviews

 - Facilitate use-case consultations that guide customers through their continuous Solutions Design and identify new workflow opportunities that drive outcomes and increase value with Notion

 - Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be best suited help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion as the underlying system

 - Help build and deliver OA programs that generate customer and business outcomes across Notion’s install base




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 4+ years of experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor—while you won't be building for your customers, you should be capable of co-design, configuring, and troubleshooting Notion workspaces and workflows

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Ability to design and help customers build workflows that drive usage based consumption, connecting adoption patterns to measurable commercial outcomes

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale

jobs.description:
Description:


Job ID: 21500
Date posted: July 23 2026
Category: Real Assets

ABOUT US:

As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.

With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different - in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.

Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com  


YOUR FUTURE RESPONSIBILITIES:

Lead the valuation process for portfolio assets and oversee the preparation and review of valuations for each NAV calculation, ensuring accuracy, consistency and compliance with applicable valuation standards and internal policies;
Drive the valuation assessment of new investment opportunities, providing independent challenge and expert judgment on pricing assumptions, methodologies and transaction structures;
Perform and oversee detailed financial, operational and market analysis of portfolio assets and the sectors in which they operate, identifying key value drivers, risks and opportunities;
Prepare and review comprehensive valuation reports, presenting valuation conclusions, methodologies, key assumptions and sensitivities to senior management and governance bodies;
Present valuation analyses and recommendations to the Valuation Committee and actively contribute to valuation-related discussions and decision-making processes;
Act as a key point of contact for valuation matters, working closely with Portfolio Management, Fund Onboarding, Risk Management, Operations & Oversight, Finance and other internal stakeholders, as well as external parties including General Partners, investment advisors/managers, auditors, third-party valuation firms, service providers and regulators;
Monitor market developments, industry trends and regulatory changes affecting valuations, ensuring that valuation methodologies remain robust and aligned with best market practices;
Contribute to the continuous enhancement of valuation policies, procedures, controls and governance frameworks across the organization;
Support and mentor junior team members, fostering technical excellence and knowledge sharing within the valuation function.


YOUR PROFILE:

You hold a Master's degree (MA/MSc/MBA or equivalent) in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Administration or a related field;
You have a minimum of 5 years of professional experience, including at least 2 years of direct valuation experience gained within asset management, advisory, valuation consulting, audit, private markets, or a similar environment;
You have strong knowledge of valuation methodologies applicable to alternative assets, including Private Equity, Real Estate and/or Infrastructure investments;
You possess a solid understanding of financial statements, financial modelling, investment analysis and valuation principles;
You demonstrate strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions and exercise sound professional judgment;
You have excellent written and verbal communication skills and are comfortable presenting complex valuation topics to senior stakeholders and governance committees;
You are able to build effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders and confidently interact with asset managers, advisers and auditors on technical valuation matters;
You proactively stay informed about market developments, valuation best practices and regulatory requirements, assessing their impact on valuation processes and outcomes;
You have a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset, strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment;
You are fluent in English

SEB is a leading international financial services group with customer bases among both private individuals and organizations. We are recognized for our expertise and customer-centric approach, which we achieve by listening to our customers, committing to quality and trust, and encouraging an entrepreneurial mindset in everything we do.

SEB Luxembourg branch serves as the hub for Private Wealth Management & Family Office (PWM&FO) services to Nordic nationals living abroad. It is also the base for many of SEB's funds and offers global custody and related depositary services to financial institutions. We are around 150 employees with more than 20 different nationalities and in the midst of further growth and expansion.

In this role, you will act as the central coordinator for insurance-related matters within PWM&FO Luxembourg and serve as the primary point of contact towards insurance companies. jobs.title: Director Finance, Operations & Supply Chain (m/f/d)
jobs.employer: HUSKY INJECTION MOLDING SYSTEMS S.A R.L.
jobs.description:
Job Description

Husky Technologies is a global leader in Injection Molding Manufacturing, committed to delivering high-quality products and services to our customers. Based in Bolton, Canada, we are seeking a Finance Director to join our dynamic team. This role will play a crucial part in providing financial leadership for our Operations and Supply Chain divisions, working closely with various functions including Purchasing, Logistics, Manufacturing, Quality, and Central Operational Support.

You will be responsible for overseeing and managing all financial aspects of our Operations & Supply Chain, ensuring that financial goals are met and that financial strategies align with the company's broader objectives. Reporting to the VP Finance, FP&A, you will serve as the right-hand finance partner to the Chief Operating Officer. This role will be based in Bolton, Canada. With five direct reports and a team of ~10 individuals based in Bolton and Luxembourg, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact on our organization's financial performance.

Key Accountabilities:

1.      Financial Planning and Analysis:

    Develop and manage the annual budget for the Operations and Supply Chain divisions.
    Provide financial guidance and insights to support decision-making processes.
    Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide monthly financial reports to the executive team.
    Lead the review and analysis of month-end and year-end financial close processes.
    Identify and analyze variances between actual results and budget/forecast, insights into the drives for variances.
    Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand the underlying factors contributing to financial performance.
    Proactively identify financial risks and opportunities, making recommendations to mitigate risks and capitalize on opportunities.
    Work closely with the executive team to refine financial strategies based on month-end and year-end insights.

2.      Cost Management:

    Transform current costing and methodology standards to improve transparency to product margins, life cycle costing and governance.
    Data and process design- Defining costing rules, master data requirements, controls, reporting definitions, and system-enabled workflows.
    Transformation accountability- Owning roadmap, requirements, testing, change management, adoption, and benefits realization.
    Collaborate closely with Supply Chain leaders to identify cost-saving opportunities and implement cost control measures across various aspects of the supply chain, including procurement, logistics, warehousing, and production.
    Develop and monitor cost reduction initiatives and targets, ensuring alignment with the company's financial goals.
    Monitor and report on key cost-related performance indicators to the executive team, providing recommendations for continuous improvement.

3.      Strategic Planning:

    Work closely with the Leadership team to develop long-term financial strategies for the Operation and Supply Chain divisions.
    Transformation accountability- Owning roadmap, requirements, testing, change management, adoption, and benefits realization.
    Assess financial impacts of potential investments in supply chain infrastructure, technology, and capabilities to improve cost and lead time.

4.      Cross Functional Leadership:

    Ability to lead Finance, Operations, IT, Service, Commercial, and regional teams through process/system change.

5.      Inventory Management:

    Collaborate with Supply Chain leaders to establish appropriate inventory targets, and improve inventory forecasting.
    Analyze the financial impact of inventory-related decisions and provide recommendations for improvement.

6.      Financial Support CAPEX (Capital Expenditures):

    Collaborate with the Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) team to assess the financial feasibility and impact of proposed capital projects within the Supply Chain division.

jobs.title: Senior Fund Accounting Officer (m/f)
jobs.description:
SENIOR FUND ACCOUNTING OFFICER

Responsibilities

The Senior Fund Accountant is responsible for the oversight and delivery of fund accounting services for a portfolio of closed‑ended Private Equity structures domiciled in Luxembourg. The role focuses on technical fund accounting, NAV oversight, review of complex transactions and financial statements, and close interaction with clients, auditors, and internal teams.

The position requires strong technical expertise in Luxembourg GAAP, a solid understanding of Luxembourg fund laws and structures (RAIF, SIF, SICAV‑SCA, SCSp, SARLs holding structures), and hands‑on experience with closed‑ended private equity fund mechanics.

Tasks

Fund Accounting & NAV Oversight

• Act as the primary reviewer and controller for NAV calculations across a portfolio of closed‑ended funds, including feeder/master and SPV structures.
• Review complex accounting areas, including excused investors, distribution waterfall mechanisms, carried interest, equalisation amongst others
• Ensure NAVs are prepared in accordance with applicable accounting standard (Luxembourg GAAP/IFRS), fund documentation, and agreed accounting policies.
• Review, challenge and approve NAVs, investor reporting, and supporting workpapers.

Financial Statements & Audit Coordination

• Review annual and interim financial statements under Lux GAAP and IFRS where applicable.
• Ensure consistency between NAVs, financial statements, and underlying accounting records.
• Act as the main point of contact for external auditors during interim and year‑end audits.
• Prepare and review responses to audit queries, including technical accounting positions and judgmental areas.
• Contribute to drafting and reviewing accounting policies and disclosure notes.

Client & Stakeholder Management

• Serve as a key contact for clients, investment managers, and other stakeholders.
• Explain complex accounting topics (unrealised FX movements, reinvestment mechanics, NAV drivers, equalisation etc) in a clear and pragmatic manner.
• Participate in client onboarding, including review of legal documentation from an accounting perspective and definition of fund‑specific accounting treatments.

Fund Onboarding & System Set‑Up

• Oversee fund onboarding activities from an accounting perspective, including: Review of fund documentation (LPA, PPM, side letters)
• Validation of chart of accounts and accounting models
• Review of data migration and opening balances
• Ensure correct setup of funds in accounting systems

Risk Management, Controls & Process Improvement

• Identify accounting and operational risks across the client portfolio and ensure appropriate controls are in place.
• Review KPIs and deliverables provided by back office or Global Delivery Teams (GCD) and challenge quality and timeliness where required.
• Support process improvements, standardisation, and automation initiatives within fund accounting

Team Support & Knowledge Sharing

• Act as a technical reference point for junior team members.
• Provide coaching, training, and on‑the‑job guidance on private equity and Luxembourg‑specific accounting topics.
• Support managers in maintaining high technical and quality standards across the team.

Required Experience / Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
• 4–6 years of experience in fund accounting within a private equity environment.
• Strong practical knowledge of Luxembourg GAAP and closed‑ended fund accounting.
• Solid understanding of Luxembourg fund structures and legal concepts (ring‑fencing, compartments/sub‑funds, master‑feeder structures).
• Experience dealing with auditors and client‑facing interactions.
• Professional qualification (ACCA or equivalent) is an advantage.
• Experience with fund accounting systems such as Investran is a strong asset.
• Fluent in English; French is an advantage.

Skills/Behavior

• Strong analytical and review skills with attention to detail.
• Ability to interpret fund documentation and translate it into accounting treatments.
• Comfortable handling complex and non‑standard transactions.
• Clear and confident communicator with internal teams and clients.
• Proactive, solutions‑oriented mindset.
• Ability to operate autonomously while collaborating effectively within a team.

jobs.title: Executive Operations Partner - EPD (Executive Assistant)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Our Executive Operations team work closely with Notion’s leadership, serving as trusted advisors, collaborators, and problem-solvers. We focus on amplifying the impact of our executives by anticipating needs, streamlining operations, and building systems that keep leaders focused on the highest leverage work. We’re deeply connected to Notion’s mission and values, and we take pride in creating an environment of collaboration, clarity, and authenticity. Our team thrives on strong relationships, operational excellence, and a shared commitment to building tools that empower people to think and work together more effectively.

This role calls for someone who is proactive, adaptable, and deeply organized. Someone who can balance complex scheduling, drive cross-functional coordination, and bring clarity to fast moving priorities. This person will support 2 leaders in our Engineering and Product orgs. Our ideal candidate thrives in dynamic environments, operates independently, and consistently finds ways to improve workflows and communication. You’ll be a key partner in making sure our leaders and the company as a whole can move quickly while staying aligned. 

 

This role is based in our New York office.We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Organizational support: Partner with Engineering and Product leaders on running the day-to-day of an efficient, high-velocity, and fun organization

 - Calendar management: Prioritize and coordinate the teams’ operating calendar, ensuring time is spent in a way that's most leveraged to achieve our business objectives

 - Meeting aficionado: Organize, attend, and track meeting notes and action items, with an eye on making every interaction productive and warm

 - Travel planner: Flights, hotels, transportation, dining, etc. A strong attention to detail here is valued

 - Expense management: Manages expense reports for the executives you support

 - Culture carrier and community builder: Craft fun & engaging team offsite experiences, celebrate birthdays and anniversaries, new family members, and promotions to ensure employees continue to feel connected and recognized




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of Executive Operations experience at fast-growing companies, ideally with experience with technical teams.

 - Organized and detail-oriented: Strong attention to detail, able to stay calm under pressure, a quick thinker, create order of out chaos

 - Effective communicator: Ability to communicate the priorities of leadership within Notion, whether it is by written, verbal, or group communication

 - Event planning: Experience organizing team events with hundreds of people, as well as multi-day events with smaller groups of people, such as an executive offsite

 - EQ: Love connecting with employees, and have proven ability to build relationships and bring warmth to all levels of the organization

 - Discreet: Demonstrated ability to maintain complete confidentiality on all business matters




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You're a Notion evangelist! You love the product, and already use it in your daily life



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $65.38 – $76.92/hr.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

jobs.title: TEHNIČKI NADZORNIK/TEHNIČKA NADZORNICA FLOTE
jobs.description:
Glavne odgovornosti uključuju:

  • nadzor tehničkog stanja plovila i brodske opreme (dizalica)
  • planiranje i praćenje preventivnog i korektivnog održavanja
  • organizaciju servisa, popravaka, remonta i dokovanja
  • koordinaciju rada vanjskih servisera, izvođača i dobavljača
  • tehničku podršku upraviteljima stroja
  • praćenje kvarova i osiguravanje njihove pravovremene sanacije
  • kontrolu tehničkih izvještaja i dokumentacije s plovila
  • praćenje rokova servisa, pregleda i certifikata tehničke opreme
  • suradnju s klasifikacijskim društvima, registrom i nadležnim tijelima
  • pripremu plovila za tehničke preglede i inspekcije
  • izradu tehničkih specifikacija i zahtjeva za nabavu
  • kontrolu ponuda, troškova održavanja
  • praćenje zaliha rezervnih dijelova i kritične opreme
  • povremene odlaske na plovila i lokacije izvođenja radova
  • sudjelovanje u tehničkom planiranju i razvoju flote

Od kandidata očekujemo:

  • tehničko ili pomorsko obrazovanje
  • iskustvo u pomorskom sektoru, brodogradnji, održavanju plovila ili srodnim tehničkim poslovima
  • dobro poznavanje sustava, strojeva i opreme
  • sposobnost samostalnog organiziranja i vođenja tehničkih aktivnosti
  • razvijene organizacijske sposobnosti i sposobnost određivanja prioriteta
  • odgovoran i praktičan pristup rješavanju tehničkih problema
  • dobro poznavanje rada na računalu i tehničke dokumentacije
  • vozačku dozvolu B kategorije
  • spremnost na povremena službena putovanja i rad na terenu
Prednost imaju kandidati s:
  • iskustvom u svojstvu upravitelja stroja, časnika stroja
  • iskustvom s radnim brodovima, tegljačima, jaružalima, multicat plovilima ili drugim specijaliziranim plovilima
  • iskustvom u organizaciji remonta, dokovanja i većih tehničkih popravaka
  • iskustvom u radu s klasifikacijskim društvima i pomorskim administracijama
  • poznavanjem sustava planiranog održavanja (PMS)
Nudimo:
  • stalni radni odnos
  • aktivno sudjelovanje u upravljanju i razvoju flote
  • dinamično radno okruženje u pomorskom sektoru
  • rad na različitim tehničkim i pomorskim projektima
  • mogućnost profesionalnog razvoja
  • stimulativna primanja u skladu s iskustvom i kvalifikacijama kandidata

jobs.title: STROJOBRAVAR U ODRŽAVANJU M/Ž
jobs.description:
Sudjeluje u godišnjem remontu svih postrojenja u društvu Opis poslova:
  • Obavlja radne zadatke prema nalogu voditelja održavanja
  • Obavlja sve strojobravarske poslove te vodi brigu o tehničkoj ispravnosti postrojenja,strojeva i opreme u društvu
  • Ispituje ispravnost mehaničkih dijelova strojeva i opreme u postrojenjima te poduzima potrebne preventivne mjere
  • Utvrđuje i otklanja kvarove te mijenja dotrajale ili neispravne dijelove
Uvjeti:
  • završena srednja škola strojarskog usmjerenja – strojobravar, bravar, mehaničar industrijskih strojeva ili drugo odgovarajuće zanimanje
  • poznavanje rada i održavanja strojeva, opreme i industrijskih postrojenja
  • radno iskustvo na istim ili sličnim poslovima je poželjno
  • vozačka dozvola B kategorije
  • odgovornost, pouzdanost, samostalnost i spremnost na timski rad
  • spremnost na rad na različitim lokacijama Društva i obavljanje hitnih intervencija
  • zdravstvena sposobnost za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta.
Uz prijavu je potrebno priložiti:
  • životopis
  • dokaz o završenom obrazovanju
  • presliku vozačke dozvole
  • dokaz o radnom iskustvu, ako ga kandidat posjeduje.

Na natječaj se mogu ravnopravno prijaviti osobe oba spola. Kandidati koji ispunjavaju uvjete mogu biti pozvani na razgovor i provjeru stručnih znanja i sposobnosti.

Dostavljanjem prijave kandidat daje privolu za obradu osobnih podataka u svrhu provedbe postupka odabira, u skladu s važećim propisima o zaštiti osobnih podataka.

Poslodavac zadržava pravo ne odabrati nijednog kandidata bez obveze obrazlaganja svoje odluke.

jobs.title: STRUČNI RADNIK/STRUČNA RADNICA NA TEHNIČKOM ODRŽAVANJU
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23) i sukladno Pravilniku o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja radnika u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ te čl. 10. Pravilnika o radu OŠ-SE „San Nicolò'“, ravnateljica Osnovne škole-Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“ Rijeka, Mirka Čurbega 18, objavljuje N A T J E Č A J za popunjenje radnog mjesta 1 STRUČNI RADNIK/STRUČNA RADNICA NA TEHNIČKOM ODRŽAVANJU za obavljanje poslova domara/školskog majstora i poslova loženja centralnog grijanja na određeno i puno radno vrijeme (zamjena) TRAŽENI UVJETI: Uz opće uvjete za zasnivanje radnog odnosa, sukladno općim propisima o radu, kandidati moraju zadovoljavati i posebne uvjete sukladno čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12., 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17 i 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23) i prema Pravilniku o djelokrugu rada tajnika te administrativno–tehničkim i pomoćnim poslovima koji se obavljaju u osnovnoj školi (Narodne novine broj 40 /14, 71/25, 74/25-ispravak):
  1. SSS tehničke struke
  2. položen stručni ispit za ložača centralnog grijanja
  3. zdravstvena sposobnost za obavljanje poslova s posebnim uvjetima rada
  4. da protiv kandidata nije pokrenut kazneni postupak za neko od kaznenih djela navedenih u čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi.
NAPOMENA: Dokaz o posebnoj zdravstvenoj sposobnosti kandidata/kinje za radno mjesto pribavlja se prije sklapanja ugovora o radu sukladno odredbi članka 24., stavka 2. i 3. Zakona o radu (NN 93/14, 127/17, 98/19, 151/22, 46/23, 64/23); Na oglašena radna mjesta mogu se javiti osobe oba spola, sukladno čl. 13. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (NN 82/16, 69/17). Svi izrazi korišteni u natječaju odnose se na osobe oba spola. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu kandidati su dužni priložiti:
  • životopis (CV),
  • dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi,
  • dokaz o položenom stručnom ispitu za ložača centralnog grijanja,
  • dokaz o državljanstvu,
  • elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje i
  • uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od 6 mjeseci od dana objave ovog natječaja.
Navedenu dokumentaciju potrebno je dostaviti neposredno ili poštom preporučeno na adresu škole, u roku od 8 dana od dana objave ovog natječaja na mrežnoj stranici Škole i mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje. Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici. Kandidati koji ostvaruju prednost pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priznatom statusu. Osobe koje se pozivaju na pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03 i 148/13, 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), dužne su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji. Vrednovanje uključuje: psihologijsko testiranje, pisanu provjeru stručnih sposobnosti koje su potrebne za obavljanje poslova ovog radnog mjesta i intervju, sve u skladu s odredbama članaka 12. – 14. Povjerenstvo za provedbu testiranja će postupiti sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ u odnosu na sve kandidate, koji udovoljavaju propisanim uvjetima, a podnijeli su potpune i pravovremene prijave. Kandidat koji se ne odazove pozivu za bilo koju fazu vrednovanja, smatrat će se da je odustao od daljnjeg natječajnog postupka. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati daju privolu za obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u svim dostavljenim prilozima odnosno ispravama za potrebe provedbe natječajnog postupka. La documentazione indicata deve pervenire all'indirizzo della scuola, consegnata personalmente o spedita per posta raccomandata, entro e non oltre il termine di 8 giorni dalla pubblicazione del presente Bando di Concorso sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato. I documenti vanno consegnati in copia non autenticata. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego, a parità di condizioni, in base a leggi specifiche, devono evocare questo diritto esplicitamente nella domanda e fornire in allegato oltre ai documenti comprovanti l'idoneità secondo i requisiti richesti, pure i documenti comprovanti lo status riconosciuto. Le persone di cui all'art.102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), art. 48. f della Legge sulla tutela degli invalidi di guerra militari e civili di (GU 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), art. 9 della Legge sulla riabilitazione professionale e l'impiego di persone disabili (GU 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) e l'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21), dovranno comprovare il loro status con la documentazione indicata nella Legge speciale, che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nei confronti degli altri candidati esclusivamente alle stesse condizioni. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego secondo l'art. 102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), dovranno allegare anche le prove indicate nell'art. 103, comma 1 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari, che si trova sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego in base all'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21), dovranno indicare questo diritto ed allegare le prove indicate nell'art. 49, comma 1 della stessa Legge, indicate sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf I candidati che hanno inoltrato le domande complete e tempestive e che soddisfano le condizioni formali del concorso partecipano nella procedura ulteriore e saranno invitati alla prova (test). La prova (test) include: test psicologici, la verifica scritta delle competenze professionali necessarie per lo svolgimento delle mansioni relative a questo posto di lavoro ed il colloquio, tutto indicato ai sensi degli articoli 12 – 14 del Regolamento sulle modalità e sulla procedura di assunzione della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”. Le domande incomplete e non pervenute entro il termine stabilito non verranno prese in considerazione. La Commissione che svolge le prove (test) per le assunzioni procederà secondo le regole stabilite dal Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione dell'OŠ-SE »San Nicolò« con tutti i candidati che soddisferanno le condizioni formali richieste e che presenteranno domande complete, entro il termine previsto. Se il candidato non accede a una delle fasi della prova (test) si considererà come se avesse rinunciato alla procedura concorsuale ulteriore. Accedendo al Bando di concorso i candidati danno il proprio consenso all'elaborazione dei dati personali presenti in tutti i documenti allegati. La Scuola avviserà tutti i candidati riguardo ai risultati del concorso, entro 8 giorni dalla data della decisione sulla scelta del candidato, pubblicando la decisione sul sito web della Scuola oppure personalmente tramite posta elettronica. Il Bando di concorso è stato pubblicato sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato il 19 agosto 2026.

jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer m/w/d (Data Scientist)
jobs.description:
At Damia Group Portugal (Permanent), in Portugal
Expires at: 2027-05-12
Remote policy: Full remoteAbout the company: Damia Group is an international tech recruitment agency with 3 decades of experience. Our arrival in Portugal, 7 years later, was set on a mission to transform IT recruitment experiences and, through them, achieve better results. We believe in long-term relationships with a transparent and relaxed mindset. In a short period, we have reached the hearts of both scale-ups and larger organisations by delivering spot-on curated candidate shortlists, increased job offer acceptance rates and shorter time-to-fill.

Main requirements

Role OverviewThis is a senior, hands-on role for someone who views Data Infrastructure as a product.You will define how billions of records are structured, indexed, and exposed to the rest of the company. Ideal for someone who combines strong backend engineering skills with deep expertise in data platforms, data lakes, and large-scale data systems. Key Responsibilities

-
Database Reliability & Scaling:

- Own the health and performance of their core databases.
- Own and optimize their MongoDB clusters and OpenSearch indexes, which houses billions of documents. You will design sharding strategies and indexing patterns to ensure search performance.
- Design and implement a multi-tier storage strategy. You will determine which data remains "hot" in production databases for their Product team and which data is offloaded to "cold/analytical" storage for AI and R&D.
-
Data Access Layer:

- Build and maintain internal APIs that allow internal teams to build features without worrying about the underlying database complexities.
-
Schema Evolution & Migrations:

- Lead the strategy for updating data structures across billions of records. You will design "no-downtime" migration paths for their production MongoDB and OpenSearch environments.
-
Data Platform & Architecture

- Own and evolve their Core Data Architecture, ensuring it supports analytics, product features, AI workflows, and internal consumption.
- Evaluate the feasibility and ROI of introducing a Data Lakehouse architecture for long-term storage and AI training.
- Define standards for how data is ingested, stored, versioned, and exposed to downstream systems.
-
Data Quality & Documentation:

- Ensure data accuracy, freshness, and consistency through validation and testing.
- Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation of pipelines, schemas, and data assets to enable internal adoption.
-
Collaboration:

- Act as a bridge between Core, Product, and R&D, ensuring research initiatives (e.g. data enrichment) are integrated into the Core platform.
- Translate business and product needs into scalable, maintainable data solutions.
- Comfortable working in async-first environments, keeping task statuses and documentation up to date for full team visibility.

What They're Looking For

- 5+ years of experience in Backend, Data Engineering and/or Data Platform roles, specifically within high-concurrency/high-volume environments.
-
NoSQL & Search Expert. Professional experience tuning MongoDB and OpenSearch/Elasticsearch at massive scale (sharding, cluster topology, query optimization).

-
Strong Python Skills. Proficiency in writing production-grade, highly efficient Python. Experience with asynchronous programming (FastAPI, etc.) for building high-performance Internal APIs is essential.

-
System Design & Architecture. A strong grasp of distributed systems, including eventual consistency, message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and caching strategies to protect production databases.

-
Strategic Storage Thinking. Familiarity with Data Lakehouse concepts (e.g., Parquet, Delta Lake, Iceberg). Proven experience building one.

- Excellent communication skills and attention to documentation.
- Self-managed and comfortable working cross-functionally.
- Fluent in English.
- Tax residency in Portugal.

Nice to have

Bonus Points

- Experience

jobs.title: IT Netzwerk-Administrator / KI-Integrator 100% (m/w/d) (KI-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
IT Netzwerk-Administrator / KI-Integrator 100% (m/w/d)

vor Ort Roggwil TG, Thurgau, Schweiz

• Ergonomische Arbeitsplätze

• Transparente Kommunikation sowie eine familiäre Unternehmenskultur

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterkonditionen und Rabatte

Jobbeschreibung

Die kybun Joya Retail AG in Roggwil gehört zur kybun Joya Gruppe, welche Komfortschuhe und weitere Gesundheitslösungen in der Schweiz entwickelt, produziert und in mehr als 40 Ländern vertreibt. Ziel ist es, den Menschen durch kompetente Beratung schmerzfreie Bewegung zu ermöglichen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Roggwil suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine teamfähige, flexible und belastbare Persönlichkeit.

Als IT Netzwerk-Administrator / KI-Integrator sind Sie das technische Rückgrat unserer digitalen Infrastruktur und gleichzeitig Motor unserer KI-Transformation. Sie sorgen für eine stabile, sichere Netzwerk- und Systemlandschaft und treiben aktiv die Integration von KI-Lösungen in unsere Geschäftsprozesse voran. Die Rolle ist eng verzahnt mit dem E-Commerce-, Support- und Marketing-Team.

Ihre Aufgaben

Netzwerk & IT-Infrastruktur

- Verwaltung und Weiterentwicklung der Netzwerkinfrastruktur an unseren Standorten Roggwil, Sennwald und unseren eigenen Shops in Europa (LAN/WLAN, Firewalls, VPN, Switching, Routing)
- Betrieb und Pflege der Server-, Client- und Cloud-Umgebung (Microsoft 365, Entra ID / Azure AD, Intune, Exchange Online, Teams Telefonie)
- Verwaltung von Endgeräten inkl. Device Enrollment, Intune-Policies und Lizenzmanagement
- Konfiguration und Pflege von Domains, DNS-, SPF- und Zertifikatsstrukturen (z. B. sichere LDAP-Zertifikate, Mail-Deliverability)
- Hardware-Beschaffung & -Verwaltung (Client/Server)
- Gelegentlicher Vor-Ort-Support für Shops, inkl. Reisetätigkeit bei Neueinrichtungen

IT-Sicherheit & Compliance

- Sicherstellung der IT-Sicherheit durch Patch-Management, Zero-Trust-Ansätze, MFA und Endpoint Protection
- Incident Response bei Sicherheitsvorfällen (z. B. Phishing, kompromittierte Accounts) inkl. interner Kommunikation
- Onboarding neuer Mitarbeitender in Sicherheitstools wie Bitwarden (Passwortmanagement)
- Unterstützung bei ISO 9001 Audits und Umsetzung von Compliance-Vorgaben

Monitoring, Support & Systempflege

- Monitoring, Troubleshooting und 2nd-Level-Support für Netzwerk, Systeme und User Requests
- Bearbeitung und Priorisierung von IT-Tickets und Weiterentwicklung des Ticket-Prozesses
- Planung und Durchführung von Systemupdates, Rollouts und Migrationen mit minimaler Downtime
- Dokumentation von Prozessen, Konfigurationen und Wissensdatenbank-Artikeln

KI-Integration & Automatisierung

- Integration von KI in bestehende Prozesse und Systeme in enger Zusammenarbeit mit E-Commerce, Kundenservice und Marketing
- Design, Erstellung und Optimierung von Prompts für generative KI-Modelle (z. B. für Übersetzungen, Kundenservice, Content-Erstellung)
- Konzeption und Umsetzung von Workflows in n8n und Anbindung an Systeme wie Shopify, Klaviyo, Gorgias, Synthflow und weitere APIs
- Betrieb und Optimierung von KI-Agenten (z. B. Gorgias AI Agent, Synthflow Telefonie, Copilot-Anwendungen)
- Qualitätssicherung und Monitoring KI-generierter Inhalte – inkl. Fehlerdiagnose, Fallback-Logik und Reporting
- Evaluation neuer KI-Tools und Modelle sowie Ableitung von Business-Use-Cases
- Schulung und Enablement interner Teams im Umgang mit KI-Tools (z. B. Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, Gorgias AI)

Stellenanforderungen

Ausbildung & Erfahrung

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium im Bereich Informatik, Systemtechnik, Netzwerktechnik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Mind. 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der IT-Administration, idealerweise in einem KMU- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld
- Erste praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit KI-Tools, Prompt Engineering und/oder Automatisierungsplattformen (n8n, Zapier, Make o. ä.)

Fachliche Kompetenzen

- Fundierte Kenntnisse in Netzwerktechnik (TCP/IP, VLAN, VPN, Firewalls, WLAN-Controller)
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in der Microsoft-365-Welt: Entra ID / Azure AD, Intune, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint
- Erfahrung mit PowerShell-Skripting oder anderen Automatisierungssprachen
- Verständnis für IT-Security-Prinzipien (MFA, Zero Trust, Endpoint Protection, Backup-Strategien)
- Grundverständnis für APIs, Webhooks und JSON zur Integration von Systemen
- Erfahrung mit oder starkes Interesse an Generativer KI, LLMs, RAG-Konzepten und Prompt-Optimierung
- Von Vorteil: Kenntnisse in Shopify, Klaviyo, Gorgias, Adyen oder vergleichbaren SaaS-Plattformen

Persönliche Stärken

- Analytisches Denken und strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
- Hohe Eigenverantwortung und Zuverlässigkeit
- Neugier und Innovationsfreude, insbesondere im Bereich KI und Digitalisierung
- Gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten – Sie können komplexe Themen verständlich erklären
- Teamplayer mit Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit
- Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisen zwischen den Standorten Roggwil und Konstanz

Sprachen

- Deutsch verhandlungssicher (C2)
- Englisch gute Kenntnisse (B2) für Dokumentation und internationale Tools/Partner

jobs.title: HR Compliance Specialist (w/m/d) (Compliance-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als HR Compliance Specialist (w/m/d).

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann auch an folgenden Standorten lokalisiert sein:

- Amadora, Portugal- Bratislava, Slowakei- Budapest, Ungarn- Madrid, Spanien- Prag, Tschechische Republik- Warschau, Polen

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- Sie sind zuständig für die Konzeption, Implementierung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung des HR-internen Kontrollsystems.- Sie koordinieren und übernehmen Aktivitäten im Bereich Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR) für HR-relevante Prozesse.- Sie entwickeln, dokumentieren und optimieren Kontrolldesigns zur Sicherstellung regulatorischer und interner Compliance-Anforderungen.- Sie überwachen die Wirksamkeit etablierter Kontrollen, analysieren Kontrollschwächen und treiben geeignete Verbesserungsmaßnahmen nach.- Sie wirken bei der Durchführung von Control-Monitoring-Aktivitäten mit und bereiten Nachweise für interne und externe Audits auf.- Sie sind zuständig für Überwachung von Cybersecurity Controls innerhalb der HR-Funktion und arbeiten eng mit Cybersecurity-, IT- und Business-Stakeholdern zusammen.- Sie beraten Prozessverantwortliche hinsichtlich Governance-, Risk- und Compliance-Anforderungen und fördern die Standardisierung von Prozessen und Kontrollen.- Sie erstellen Management-Reports, Dashboards und Entscheidungsvorlagen für Führungskräfte und relevante Governance-Gremien.

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Master-Studium der Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsrecht, Compliance, Risikomanagement oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Compliance, Internal Controls, Audit, Risk Management oder Governance.- Sie haben fundierte Erfahrung mit internen Kontrollsystemen (ICS), ICFR-/SOX-nahen Anforderungen oder Audit-Prozessen.- Sie haben gute Kenntnisse von HR-Prozessen sowie deren Risiko- und Kontrollanforderungen sind von Vorteil.- Sie haben fundierte Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Stakeholdern und funktionsübergreifenden Teams.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.- Sie haben keinen Studienabschluss? Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Berufsausbildung in Verbindung mit einer qualifizierten Weiterbildung und darauf bezogene umfangreiche fachspezifische Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über fließende Englischkenntnisse, gute Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil- Sie verfügen über ein ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise.- Sie können komplexe Compliance- und Kontrollanforderungen verständlich vermitteln.- Sie arbeiten eigenständig, lösungsorientiert und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch.- Sie überzeugen durch Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Stakeholder ohne direkte Weisungskompetenz zu beeinflussen.- Sie bringen eine hohe Integrität sowie ein ausgeprägtes Risiko- und Verantwortungsbewusstsein mit.- Sie treiben Veränderungen aktiv voran und fördern eine nachhaltige Compliance- und Kontrollkultur.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist Klaus Kouril.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

Siemens Healthineers Deutschland wurde mit dem Zertifikat Great Place to Work® ausgezeichnet.

jobs.title: Technician 1
jobs.description:
Join Our Team!

Sunbelt Rentals strives to be the customer's first choice in the equipment rental industry. From pumps to scaffolding to general construction tools, we aim to be the only call needed to outfit a job site with the proper equipment. Not only do we offer a vast fleet that ranks among the best in the industry, we pair it all with a friendly and knowledgeable staff. Our employees are our greatest asset, and although we present a comprehensive equipment offering, our expertise and service are what truly distinguish us from the competition.

We pride ourselves on investing in our workforce and offer competitive benefits, as well as extensive on-the-job training for all eligible employees.

As a highly successful national company, we are constantly looking for talented individuals to support our growth. If you are interested in pursuing a rewarding career, we invite you to review our opportunities!

Job Description Summary

Technician 1

Are you seeking an entrepreneurial, empowering workplace that allows you to:

  • Build skills by working on a variety of makes, models & equipment
  • Develop new skills for a career track in service or operation management
  • Work with an incredible team of people in a safety-focused environment

Sunbelt Rentals--the fastest growing rental business in North America--is seeking a Technician.

This Technician role performs preventive maintenance and makes repairs on equipment in the safest, most effective way possible to avoid downtime. Our fleet varies by location but primarily include Aerial Work Platforms, general construction tools and equipment. Our specialty lines locations may have a fleet of large-scale power-generators, pumps, HVAC systems and oil/gas related equipment.

Education or experience that prepares you for success:

  • High school diploma or GED required, some trade school or equivalent training desired
  • 1 to 3 years of Technician experience with diesel equipment, heavy construction equipment or

specialty lines equipment (large-scale generators, pumps, HVAC or Oil & Gas equipment) strongly

Preferred

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities you may rely on:

  • May need to provide tools of trade
  • Knowledge of hydraulic systems and troubleshooting fundamentals

The physical demands of this role require bending, squatting, crouching, reaching, lifting 50 pounds or more, and working indoors/outdoors when required by the job. Töö hõlmab erinevaid põllumajandus- ja loomakasvatustöid, tagades talu sujuva toimimise taluniku puudumisel. Hindab ja jälgib klientide terviseseisundit, sealhulgas elutähtsaid näitajaid, haavade seisundit ning lamatiste tekke riski. Teostab õendustoiminguid, sh haavaravi ning osaleb terviseprobleemide ennetamises ja varajases märkamises. Hindab vaimset tervist ning viib läbi terviseedenduslikke tegevusi ja grupisekkumisi (nt unehügieeni ja rahunemistehnikate teemal). Korraldab sõeluuringutes osalemist ning hindab elukeskkonna ja abivahendite vajadust. Dokumenteerib õendustegevused vastavalt kehtivatele nõuetele. Teeb koostööd erihooldusteenusel oleva inimese, tema lähedaste või eestkostja, hoolduspersonali ning pere- ja eriarstidega.

Muud nõuded: Oskus hinnata inimese terviseseisundit ning teostada õendustoiminguid iseseisvalt ja professionaalselt.
Kogemus või valmisolek teha koostööd perearstide, eriarstide ning teiste tervishoiu- ja sotsiaalvaldkonna spetsialistidega. Hea digipädevus ja oskus kasutada tervishoiu infosüsteeme ning teisi tehnoloogilisi lahendusi oma töös. Isikuomadused: Empaatiline ja lugupidav suhtumine erivajadustega inimestesse. Lisaks kogenud elektrikele ootame kandideerima ka elektrialast kutse- või kõrgharidust omandavaid noori. Hindame eelkõige õppimissoovi, kohusetundlikkust ja tahet areneda professionaalseks elektriala spetsialistiks. Edukal kandidaadil on võimalus kasvada

Tööülesanded: Otsime oma meeskonda kogemustega üldelektrikut, kelle peamisteks tööülesanneteks on:
elektripaigaldiste ehitus uusehitistes ja rekonstrueeritavatel objektidel; kaablite, kaablikandurite ja elektritorustike paigaldamine; pistikupesade, lülitite, valgustite ning elektrikilpide paigaldamine; elektrikilpide koostamine ja ühendamine; rikete diagnoosimine ning kõrvaldamine; nõrkvoolusüsteemide (andmeside, ATS, valve, fonolukud jm) paigaldamine vastavalt oskustele; tööde teostamine vastavalt projektile, standarditele ja kvaliteedinõuetele.

Omalt poolt pakume: stabiilset tööd arenevas ettevõttes;
kaasaegseid töövahendeid; tööriideid ja kvaliteetseid tööriistu; konkurentsivõimelist töötasu vastavalt oskustele ja kogemustele; võimalust areneda objektijuhiks või elektritööde projektijuhiks; huvitavaid ja mitmekesiseid objekte Tallinnas ja Harjumaal; toetavat ja professionaalset meeskonda.

jobs.title: Buldooserijuht
jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: Buldooseriga tehtavad tööd peamiselt teede- ja keskkonnaehituse objektidel üle Eesti.

Omalt poolt pakume: Ausat töösuhet, heas korras tehnikat, toetavat meeskonda, tööautot.
Töötame Eesti piires. Pakume majutust ja transporti. Majutus on hostel tüüpi majutuses, kui majutuses pakutakse hommikusööki, tasub ettevõte hommikusöögi eest. Kas elamispinda jagatakse või ööbitakse üksi toas, sõltub objekti asukohast. Tööle sõitmise kulud tasub tööandja, eelnevalt lepitakse kokku, kas tööandja poolt on tööauto või soovib isik kasutada oma transporti.

Muud nõuded: Hindame kohusetundlikkust ja ausust. Kasuks tuleb varasem buldooserijuhi töökogemus.

jobs.title: Müüja-klienditeenindaja
jobs.description:
Põltsamaa Meie toidukaubad

kaupade vastuvõtmine ning ladustamine; lettide ja riiulite kaupadega täitmine ning nende korrashoiu tagamine; realiseerimisaegade ja kauba käitlemisnõuete jälgimine; puhtuse hoidmine kaupluses, muud tegevused, mis võivad klienditeeninduses ette tulla.

Omalt poolt pakume: Tööalast väljaõpet kohapeal, tulemustele orienteeritud töötasu, ettevõttesisest arenguvõimalust, toetavat ja sõbralikku meeskonda.

Kasuks tuleb eelnev kogemus jaekaubanduses.

jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: Otsime klassiõpetajat 1.klassile.

Omalt poolt pakume: Liitudes Hiiu Kooli kooliperega:
saad alustada tööd sügisel kooliteed alustava 1. klassiga; saad teha missiooniga tööd kokkuhoidvas ja sõbralikus meeskonnas ning õpetada motiveeritud ja särasilmseid õpilasi; toetavat meeskonda ja mentorit, et saaksid võimalikult kiiresti ühiseid töövõite nautida; koos õppida ja areneda, osaledes projektides ja panustada uue kooli arengusse; töötada kaasaegse ja loova õpikeskkonnaga koolis, mis säilitab sinu töörõõmu; pakume koostöist ja kaasavat koolikultuuri, et saaksid töö- ja eraelu sujuvalt ühendada.

Muud nõuded: Põhikooli ja gümnaasiumi õpetaja kvalifikatsiooninõuded on:
1) magistrikraad või sellele vastav kvalifikatsioon, õpetajakutse ning eesti keele oskus vastavalt keeleseaduses ja selle alusel kehtestatud nõuetele või 2) doktorikraad või sellele vastav kvalifikatsioon ning eesti keele oskus vastavalt keeleseaduses ja selle alusel kehtestatud nõuetele. [RT I, 07.01.2026, 3 - jõust. 17.01.2026] (5) Põhikooli valikaine ja gümnaasiumi valikkursuse õpetaja kvalifikatsiooninõuded on kõrgharidus, pedagoogilised kompetentsid ning eesti keele oskus vastavalt keeleseaduses ja selle alusel kehtestatud nõuetele. (6) Käesoleva paragrahvi lõigetes 2 ja 4 nimetatud õpetajakutse saadakse ülikoolis pärast õpetajakoolituse õppekava läbimist või kutset andva organi juures pärast õpetaja ametiks vajalike pedagoogiliste kompetentside tõendamist. Õpetajate pedagoogilised kompetentsid on kirjeldatud õpetaja kutsestandardis.

Kui oled oma valdkonnas professionaal ja suudad teha kvaliteetset tööd, siis see võib olla just sulle sobiv töökoht!

jobs.title: Farmimehaanik
jobs.description:
Otsime oma meeskonda farmimehaanikut, kes aitaks hoida töös meie suure piimafarmi tehnika ja seadmed.

Tööülesanded: Oleme edukas ja arenev põllumajandusettevõte, kus väärtustame kaasaegseid lahendusi, tugevat meeskonda ja inimesi, kes tahavad oma tööga päriselt midagi ära teha.
Farmis on ligikaudu 1000 looma, mistõttu on tehniliste süsteemide sujuv toimimine meie igapäevatöös väga olulisel kohal. See on hea võimalus inimesele, kes soovib teha praktilist ja mitmekesist tööd ning olla osa ettevõttest, mis areneb, investeerib ja kasvab. Sinu tööks saab olema: - farmi masinate ja seadmete hooldus ning remont; - lüpsi- ja muude farmiseadmete rikete tuvastamine ning kõrvaldamine; - tehnosüsteemide korrasoleku jälgimine; - ennetavate hooldustööde tegemine; - erinevate tehniliste probleemide lahendamine; - koostöö farmi meeskonna ja teiste tehnikutega.

Omalt poolt pakume: - Olla osa professionaalsest ja toetavast meeskonnast;
- teha mitmekesist tööd kaasaegses piimafarmis; - arendada oma tehnilisi teadmisi ja oskusi; - töötada erinevate seadmete ja tehnosüsteemidega; - kaasa rääkida ja oma teadmistega ettevõtte arengusse panustada; - kindlat ja pikaajalist töökohta; - töötasu suurus sõltub oskustest ning panusest; - vajalikud töövahendid ja tööriided; - ametiauto.

Muud nõuded: Meie ootused:
Sul on hea tehniline taip ja praktiline mõtlemine; oskad või soovid õppida masinaid ja seadmeid remontima; oled iseseisev, kohusetundlik ja lahendustele orienteeritud; hindad vaheldusrikast tööd ja soovid oma töö tulemust päriselt näha. Varasem kogemus piimafarmis ei ole tingimata vajalik. Olulisem on huvi tehnika vastu, õppimisvõime ja soov areneda.

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

jobs.title: Tugiisik
jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: Kas tunned, et soovid teha tööd, millel on päriselt tähendus? Kas lastega suhtlemine toob sulle rõõmu ning soovid olla kellelegi toeks tema igapäevases kasvamises ja arengus?
Meie meeskond ootab endaga liituma tugiisikut, kes soovib panustada laste heaolusse, turvatundesse ja enesekindluse kasvamisse. Sinu roll tugiisikuna: olla lapsele igapäevane toetaja ja julgustaja; aidata kaasa lapse arengule ja iseseisvuse kujunemisele; luua turvaline ja hooliv keskkond; teha koostööd pere ja spetsialistidega.

Omalt poolt pakume: Püsivat tööd;
Toetavat meeskonda ja sisekoolitusi; Tähendusrikast ja südantsoojendavat tööd; Toetavat meeskonda ja juhendamist; Võimalust päriselt midagi muuta ühe lapse elus.

Muud nõuded: Otsime tugiisikuid, kes sobivad hästi lastega, on kohusetundlikud ja peavad kinni kokkulepetest ning on soovitavalt läbinud tugiisiku koolituse või valmis seda läbima.
Ootame sind, kui: hoolid lastest ja soovid nendega töötada; oled kannatlik, empaatiline ja usaldusväärne; suudad märgata lapse vajadusi ja pakkuda tuge; oled valmis õppima ja arenema. See ei ole lihtsalt töö – see on võimalus olla kellelegi oluline tugi ja turvatunne.

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

jobs.title: Turvasüsteemide tehnik / nõrkvoolusüsteemide hooldustehnik
jobs.description:
Valve-, video-, läbipääsu-, fonoluku- ja automaatikasüsteemide paigaldus- ja hooldustehnik

Tööülesanded: Turva- ja nõrkvoolusüsteemide paigaldus, hooldus ja remont.
Peamised tööülesanded: - valvesüsteemide paigaldus, hooldus ja rikete kõrvaldamine; - videovalvesüsteemide ja salvestusseadmete paigaldus ning seadistamine; - läbipääsusüsteemide ja fonolukkude paigaldus, hooldus ja remont; - värava- ja ukseautomaatika seadistamine ning rikete lahendamine; - kaabeldustööd, seadmete ühendamine ja kontroll; - kliendiga suhtlemine objektil; - tehtud tööde dokumenteerimine ja hooldusaktide täitmine.

Omalt poolt pakume: - stabiilset tööd turva- ja automaatikasüsteemide valdkonnas;
- tööd peamiselt Tallinnas ja Harjumaal; - vajalikke tööriistu, tööriideid ja tehnilisi vahendeid; - vajadusel ametiauto kasutamise võimalust töösõitudeks; - väljaõpet ja täiendkoolitusi; - võimalust taotleda Turvasüsteemide tehnik, tase 4 kutset; - töötasu vastavalt kogemusele ja oskustele.

Muud nõuded: - praktiline kogemus turva-, nõrkvoolu-, automaatika- või elektrisüsteemidega;
- oskus töötada iseseisvalt ja lahendada tehnilisi probleeme; - oskus lugeda lihtsamaid tehnilisi skeeme ja jooniseid; - korrektne ja vastutustundlik suhtumine töösse; - valmisolek suhelda klientidega eesti ja vene keeles; - valmisolek liikuda objektide vahel Tallinnas ja Harjumaal. Kasuks tuleb: - Turvasüsteemide tehnik, tase 4 kutse; - kogemus ATS, videovalve, valvesüsteemide, läbipääsusüsteemide või fonolukkudega; - teadmised IP-võrkudest ja seadmete kaugühendustest.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Executive, AI - San Francisco
Rasketehnika mehaanik
jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: Rasketehnika ja seadmete remont ning tehniline hooldus.
Sadamakraanade, ekskavaatorite, laadurite, sõidukite ja konveierite hooldus ning remont. Seadmete tehnilise seisukorra jälgimine ja rikete tuvastamine. Tehniliste rikete kõrvaldamine ning seadmete töökindluse tagamine. Töötamine peainseneri teenistuse meeskonnas.

Omalt poolt pakume: Põnevat ja mitmekesist tööd kaasaegse rasketehnikaga.
Tööks vajalikke tööriideid, jalanõusid ja isikukaitsevahendeid. Võimalust professionaalselt areneda tehnika hooldus- ja remonditööde valdkonnas. Kogenud ja pühendunud kolleege. Koostööd laialdaste teadmiste ja oskustega professionaalses meeskonnas.

Varasem kogemus masinate ja seadmete rikete diagnoosimisel ning remontimisel. Head teadmised sisepõlemismootoritest, hüdraulikast ja pneumaatikast. Hea lukksepatööoskus ja tehniline taiplikkus. Valmisolek omandada uusi erialaseid teadmisi ja oskusi. Kohusetundlikkus, vastutustunne ja kokkulepetest kinnipidamine. Valmisolek töötada välitingimustes ja kõrgustes. Valmisolek töötada graafiku alusel ning vajadusel reageerida väljakutsetele väljaspool tavapärast töögraafikut. Keevitamisoskus ja teadmised masinaehitusest tulevad kasuks. jobs.title: Korrosioonitõrje tehnik
jobs.description:
Mazda ABI Mustamäe

Tööülesanded: Korrosioonitõrje tehniku tööülesandeks on sõidu ja pakiautode korrosioonitõrje tööde teostamine. Korrosioonitõrje tööde läbiviimiseks eemaldatakse esmalt auto põhjaplastid ja logarid seejärel pestakse auto põhi ja rattakoopad porist ja mustusest puhtaks. Järgmises etapis kaetakse kinni korrosioonitõrje vahendiga mittetöödeldavad pinnad. Kui auto on ettevalmistatud siis kantakse erinevad korrosioonitõrje vahendid auto põhjale ja rattakoobastesse. Peale ainete pealekandmist kontrollitakse tehtud tööd üle ja paigaldatakse tagasi kõik eemaldatud osad.

Omalt poolt pakume: • Korrosioonitõrje tehniku väljaõpet kohapeal
• Väärilist tasu tehtud töö eest • Tööriietust ja kaitsevahendeid • Täienduskoolitusi • Sporditoetust

Muud nõuded: Ootame oma väiksesse sõbralikku meeskonda töökat korrosioonitõrje tehnikut. Kes tahab kaitsta autosid meie karmi kliima ja soola eest. Oma töö kvaliteetseks teostamiseks on vaja sul head käelist osavust, täpsust ja kohusetundlikust, et kõik lahtivõetud detailid saaks korrektselt oma kohale tagasi ja kõik tööd õigeaegselt valmis.

jobs.title: Chef de Projet Data (F/H) - BPCE ES - CDI - Puteaux h/f
jobs.description:
Description de l'entreprise
Le Groupe BPCE, avec son modèle de banque coopérative universelle, représenté par 9 millions de sociétaires, est le deuxième acteur bancaire en France. Avec 105 000 collaborateurs, il est au service de 30 millions de clients dans le monde, particuliers, professionnels, entreprises, investisseurs et collectivités locales. Il est présent dans la banque de proximité et l'assurance en France avec ses deux grands réseaux Banque Populaire et Caisse d'Epargne ainsi que la Banque Palatine. Chez BPCE Equipment Solutions, nous sommes spécialisés en financement des ventes et des équipements professionnels aux entreprises et nous sommes leader en Europe et n°2 mondial sur notre marché. Avec environ 1 600 collaborateurs répartis à l'international nous sommes régulièrement primés notamment aux Leasing Life Awards en tant que "SME Champion of the year" et / ou « European Lessor of the year ». Entité à taille humaine, agile et innovante, rejoignez-nous pour partager notre Vision : "We want to be a leading provider of innovative and flexible solutions to finance and manage equipment. We are a digital and customer-centric organization, committed to deliver an excellent experience to vendors partners and clients across countries. We are a great place to work, driven by simplicity, agility and sustainability."
Poste et missions
Vos missions au sein de l'équipeVous rejoignez l'équipe de Vincent, composée de 25 personnes en tant que Chef de Projet Data.Vous intégrerez l'équipe Data en place au sein de BPCE ES, répartie entre Paris et Bangalore. Cette équipe a en charge la gestion de la plateforme Data utilisée pour le pilotage commercial, financier, risque et Conformité de BPCE ES. Elle est aussi porteuse des principes Data à appliquer dans les projets de la Business Unit, sur la Data Quality ou la Protection des données.Dans cette équipe, vous aurez notamment l'occasion de contribuer au programme d'intégration de BPCE ES dans le Groupe BPCE, ainsi qu'au support des sujets transverses de la filière Data.Au quotidien, vous avez pour missions :Gestion de projet :Piloter et coordonner des projets Data.Assurer le suivi des plannings, des budgets et des ressources allouées.Organiser et animer les réunions de suivi de projet.Identifier et gérer les risques et les dépendances entre les projets.Analyse métier :Recueillir et analyser les besoins métiers en matière de data.Rédiger des cahiers des charges fonctionnels et techniques.Assurer l'interface entre les métiers et les équipes techniques.Participer à la conception des solutions data en collaboration avec les architectes et les développeurs.Amélioration continue :Proposer des améliorations des processus et des outils existants.Veiller à la qualité des données et à leur cohérence.Participer à la définition et au suivi des indicateurs de performance.Communication :Rendre compte régulièrement de l'avancement des projets à la direction.Assurer la communication entre les différentes parties prenantes.Former et accompagner les utilisateurs dans l'appropriation des solutions data.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Un groupe engagé dans les enjeux sociétaux et environnementaux
En intégrant le Groupe BPCE, vous évoluez dans un environnement de travail hybride et favorisant le collaboratif. En tant qu'employeur responsable et engagé à construire un environnement de travail inclusif, nous offrons les mêmes opportunités aux talents de tous horizons, indépendamment de votre âge, origine, orientation sexuelle, handicap. Vous intégrerez un environnement international, au sein d'une communauté d'experts qui place l'excellence, l'impact et l'action collective au cœur de tout ce qu'elle entreprend.
Profil et compétences requises
Vous possédez une expérience d'au-moins 5 ans dans ce rôle, dans le domaine bancaire et autour des process métier lié au pilotage d'activité commerciale, risque et finance, idéalement dans le leasing.
Les compétences attendues sont :
- Connaissance des méthodes agiles et des outils de gestion de projet (JIRA, etc.)
- Maîtrise des outils d'analyse de données (SQL, Excel, Power BI, etc.)
- Connaissance des réglementations liées à la protection des données (RGPD)
- Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles et de communication
- Sens de l'organisation, autonomie et esprit d'équipe
- Leadership et capacité à fédérer une équipe
- Esprit d'analyse et de synthèse
- Capacité à travailler sous pression et à respecter les délais
- Orienté résultats et satisfaction client

Une expérience de développement off-shore serait un plus.

jobs.title: Cook –Authentic Uyghur Hand-Pulled Noodles and Central Asian Cuisine
jobs.description:
Uyghur Noodle House is a restaurant in Helsinki specialising in fresh handmade noodles and authentic Central Asian cuisine.

We are recruiting two full-time cooks for two separate positions:

1. Cook specialising in handmade and hand-pulled noodles

2. Cook specialising in Central Asian cuisine


POSITION 1: HANDMADE AND HAND-PULLED NOODLE COOK

Main duties:

Preparing noodle dough from raw ingredients Kneading, resting, portioning, stretching and cooking the dough Producing fresh handmade and hand-pulled noodles during daily restaurant service Preparing laghman and other traditional noodle products Ensuring consistent noodle texture, thickness, portion size and quality Preparing ingredients and organising the noodle workstation before service Working efficiently during busy service periods Cleaning and maintaining the equipment and work area

Requirements:

At least three years of professional experience in handmade or hand-pulled noodle preparation Ability to complete the entire noodle-making process independently, starting from dough preparation Ability to maintain consistent quality and speed during busy restaurant service Willingness to complete a practical noodle-making skills test

POSITION 2: CENTRAL ASIAN CUISINE COOK

Main duties:

Preparing traditional Central Asian dishes, including pilaf, samsa, grilled lamb skewers and whole roasted lamb Preparing dough, fillings and seasonings for traditional samsa Selecting, cutting, seasoning and marinating lamb and other ingredients Preparing and grilling lamb skewers according to traditional methods Preparing, seasoning and roasting whole lamb Controlling cooking temperature, timing, flavour, portion size and presentation Preparing and portioning ingredients before service Maintaining consistent taste and quality Following food safety, hygiene and halal food preparation standards Cleaning and maintaining ovens, grills, kitchen equipment and work areas

COMMON REQUIREMENTS:

Ability to follow food safety, hygiene and halal food preparation standards Ability to cooperate with other kitchen employees Ability to provide reliable evidence of previous professional experience A Finnish Hygiene Passport, or willingness to obtain one within the legally required period

Demonstrated professional experience in Central Asian, Uyghur or Northwestern Chinese halal cuisine, including culinary traditions associated with Xinjiang, Gansu and Xian, is considered an advantage.

Language skills in English, Uzbek, Chinese or Uyghur are considered an advantage. These language skills are not mandatory selection requirements, and Finnish is not required.

We offer permanent, full-time employment for both positions. The regular working time is 112.5 hours per three-week period. The work includes evening and weekend shifts. Salary and other employment conditions are determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and the employees professional experience.

Applicants should clearly indicate whether they are applying for Position 1, Position 2, or both positions.

Rattaché.e au gérant et au responsable multisites, vous supervisez 2 centres de vacances situés à Crest-Voland et au Cernix.

- Accueil des groupes

- Disponibilité pour les points quotidiens
- Suivi de la satisfaction du groupe

- Réception et rangement des livraisons
- Suivi des stocks
- Vérification du linge de la blanchisserie (couettes, oreillers, housses)
- Coordination des interventions techniques
- Suivi et application des procédures d'urgence

Profil recherché :
- Expérience confirmée (minimum 2 ans) en direction de centres de vacances, tourisme de groupe ou tourisme social ou en accueil collectif de mineurs.
- Manager de terrain : capacité à allier vision globale et présence quotidienne sur plusieurs sites.
- Sens aigu du service, excellent relationnel et communication claire avec les équipes et les responsables de groupes.
- Grande rigueur, esprit d'anticipation, capacité d'adaptation, capacité de prise de décision et polyvalence
- Connaissance des règles HACCP et des normes de sécurité (formation prévue).
- Permis B indispensable.
