jobs.title: Media Manager
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Replit is investing seriously in paid media — TV, CTV, online video, out-of-home, audio, social, and search — and we need the person who makes that investment work. This role is the internal owner of our media program: you'll direct our external media agencies, pressure-test their plans, steward the budget, and hold every dollar accountable for reaching the right audiences on the right channels at the right time.

You'll report to the VP of Marketing and act as the connective tissue between our brand and growth teams and our agency partners. This is not a hands-on-keyboard activation role. You won't be living in Ads Manager — you'll be the person who briefs the agency, challenges the channel mix, catches the pacing problem before it becomes a budget problem, and translates campaign performance into decisions leadership can act on.

This is the right role if you've sat on the brand side (or want to move there from a media agency), you know what a great media plan looks like and what a lazy one looks like, and you get energy from being the sharpest media mind in the room without needing to touch the platforms yourself.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Agency leadership: Serve as the primary day-to-day partner to our media agencies. Set strategy direction, write clear briefs, run planning cycles and QBRs, and hold partners accountable for performance, optimization, quality, and business results.

 - Plan interrogation: Review and challenge agency recommendations across every channel — TV, CTV, OLV, OOH, audio, social, search, programmatic. Catch weak rationale, frequency saturation risks, and budget misallocations before plans get approved.

 - Budget stewardship: Own media budget pacing, forecasting, authorizations, and reconciliation in partnership with Finance. Monitor spend and delivery mid-flight, flag risks early, and drive reallocations when the data says to.

 - Media strategy & planning: Lead annual, quarterly, and campaign-level planning with the agency. Make sure plans reflect our audiences, product moments, competitive pressure, and business goals — not just what's easy to buy.

 - Measurement & accountability: Define campaign KPIs and measurement frameworks with the agency and our analytics team. Own wrap reports, drive a test-and-learn agenda (incrementality, brand lift, MMM as we scale), and go beyond CPMs and impressions to reach efficiency and cost-per-outcome.

 - Executive reporting: Distill campaign and channel performance into clear recommendations for marketing leadership. Tell us what worked, what didn't, and what we should do differently — with numbers behind it.

 - Cross-functional alignment: Partner with Brand, Growth, Creative, Product Marketing, Social, and Comms so media plans amplify what the rest of marketing is building, and so creative assets fit the placements we're buying.



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - 5+ years of media planning and strategy experience, either brand-side managing external agencies or at a media agency serving major consumer brands

 - Demonstrated experience independently reviewing and challenging agency media plans, not just executing against them

 - Experience managing multi-million dollar media budgets across concurrent campaigns, including pacing, forecasting, and mid-flight reallocation

 - Fluency across the full channel landscape: TV/CTV, online video, OOH, audio/podcasts, paid social, search, and programmatic — you can evaluate rates, rationale, and audience fit in any of them

 - Strong command of media measurement: reach and frequency, brand lift, incrementality testing, and marketing mix modeling

 - Sharp analytical skills; you can work from raw campaign data to find performance trends and budget inefficiencies, and you're at home in Excel

 - Strong stakeholder management across Finance, Analytics, Creative, and agency teams; you write briefs people can actually work from

 - AI-native: actively using AI tools to speed up analysis, reporting, and planning work — you're not just aware of them, you're using them daily

 - Comfort operating in ambiguity and at speed; you don't need committee consensus to make smart decisions



BONUS QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience at a high-growth consumer tech, B2C, or AI company

 - Agency alumni who've made (or want to make) the move to the client side

 - Experience standing up a media function or measurement framework from scratch

 - Experience with OOH and large cultural-moment buys (sponsorships, tentpole events)

 - A point of view on how AI is changing media planning and buying — and what most brands get wrong about it

 - Active Replit user; you've built and shipped something with the product

 - Based in or able to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

Job Purpose: Firefighter is responsible for responding to aircraft and structural fire emergencies, medical emergencies, hazardous material incidents, and other emergencies within the airport premises. This role involves ensuring the safety and security of passengers, crew, and airport personnel by performing firefighting, rescue and emergency medical services.

Responsibilities

Emergency Response:

Respond promptly to aircraft incidents, structural fires, medical emergencies, hazardous materials incidents, and other emergency situations on airport property.

Perform firefighting, rescue, and emergency medical services to ensure the safety of individuals and property.

Fire Suppression

Extinguish fires using various firefighting techniques, including the use of water, foam, dry chemicals, and other firefighting agents.

Conduct search and rescue operations in smoke-filled and hazardous environments.

Emergency Medical Services

Provide first aid and basic life support (BLS) to injured or ill individuals until advanced medical personnel arrive.

Assist in the transportation of patients to medical facilities as needed.

Operational Readiness

Perform daily inspections and maintenance of firefighting vehicles, extinguishers, and personal protective equipment (PPE).

Maintain inventory of firefighting supplies and equipment and ensure their readiness for use.

Participate in routine emergency response simulations, ICAO-mandated training, and fire drills.

Maintain detailed incident reports, training records, and shift logs for regulatory audits.

Compliance And Reporting

Adhere to all local, state, and federal regulations and guidelines related to firefighting and emergency response and ensure all tasks are performed following Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

Identify potential hazards during patrols and inspections, ensuring immediate corrective action.

Prepare and submit accurate incident reports, equipment logs, and other required documentation.

Collaboration And Coordination

Collaborate with airport operations, medical services, and external emergency agencies during incidents.

Coordinate with the Duty Manager, ATC, and airport authorities during emergency operations and drills.

Key Stakeholders - Internal

Duty Manager - ARFF

Airport Operations Team

Airport Security

Emergency Medical Services

ARFF Crew Members

Engineering & Maintenance Team

Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) Team

Key Stakeholders - External

Local Fire Services Department

Airlines Operating at the Airport

Ground Handling Companies

ARFF Equipment Manufacturers/Service Providers

Insurance Companies

Local Community Leaders

Civil Aviation Authorities

Qualifications

Education Qualification:

Diploma in Fire Fighting Technology or equivalent qualification.

Certification from an accredited firefighting academy is required.

SHORT ANSWERAsk questions that show you've already started solving their problems, not just learning about the company. Focus on how your unique skills will contribute to their specific goals, using details from the job posting and your resume to frame your inquiries. Your questions should reveal your strategic value, not just your curiosity.

That moment at the end of an interview, when they turn the tables and ask, "Do you have any questions for us?" can feel like a pop quiz. Most anxious job seekers just want to get through it, but this is actually your final, best chance to show them you're the solution to their problems. I promise, you can turn this moment into a powerful demonstration of your value.

ONE LINE EACH Who I am The proof What I want next say it in one breath

FIG. 02I used to ramble when someone asked what I did. Now I keep three lines ready: who I am, the proof, and what I want next. When all three stack into one breath, people remember you.

  • 01 How do I show I've already started thinking about their problems?

Frame your questions around specific challenges or goals mentioned in the job posting or throughout the interview, demonstrating youâre already in problem-solving mode for them. This shifts you from interviewee to potential partner, showing youâre not just looking for a job, but for impact. Youâre not asking what they do; youâre asking how you can help them do it better.

For example, if the posting mentions expanding into a new market, you might ask, "I noticed the posting highlighted a push into the APAC region. What specific metrics are you tracking for success in that expansion over the next 12 months, and how do you see this role directly contributing to those early wins?" This tells them you read the posting, you understand their strategic direction, and you're already thinking about measurable outcomes. It's a much stronger signal than, "What's the team culture like?" I want you to make every question a mini pitch for your specific skills.

  • 02

Should I ask about the 30/60/90 day plan?

Asking about the 30/60/90 day plan is a smart move, but only if you frame it to show how you'd execute your own plan, not just hear theirs. This question can reveal critical expectations and allow you to align your prepared 30/60/90 day plan from your Baldwin Blueprint with their vision. It's about demonstrating initiative and foresight.

Instead of "What would my 30/60/90 day plan look like?" try, "Based on our conversation about [specific challenge or project], what would be the top one or two priorities you'd want someone in this role to tackle and deliver measurable results on within their first 90 days?" This invites them to share their critical needs, and you can then connect those needs to your own Experience Accelerator and 30/60/90 day plan, which your Blueprint helps you build from the actual job posting. It shows you're not just waiting for instructions; you're ready to hit the ground running with concrete contributions.

Four rooms, four scorecards Manager Peer Partner Skip level JUDGMENT CRAFT TEAMWORK GROWTH answer the real scorer

FIG. 03An interview loop is not one test, it is four. Each person in the room is measuring a different thing: the hiring manager scores judgment, the peer scores craft, the cross functional partner scores collaboration, and the skip level scores trajectory. Speak to what each one is actually grading. Build this for your role.Paste a real posting, get the 12 page plan. First draft free.Start free

  • 03 What's a question that shows I'm thinking long-term?

A question that shows you're thinking long-term connects your potential contributions to the company's broader strategic goals, positioning you as an investment, not just a hire. This demonstrates ambition and a desire to grow with the company, making your candidacy more compelling. Itâs about signaling that you see a future with them.

Consider asking, "Beyond the immediate responsibilities, what are the biggest strategic shifts or initiatives this team expects to navigate in the next 18 to 24 months, and how does this role evolve to support those changes?" This shows you're looking beyond the immediate tasks and are interested in the trajectory of the company and your potential role within it. It's a question that conveys seriousness about your career and their future, which hiring managers appreciate. It pushes past the tactical and into the strategic, which is where true impact lies.

THEY ASK Any questions for us? YOU ASK Where do projects stall before they ship? this is the interview too

FIG. 04The questions you ask are part of the interview, not a polite afterthought. When they ask if you have questions, skip the perks and ask about the real work: what success looks like in 90 days, where projects stall, who owns the roadmap. The questions you ask reveal how you think, so make them sharp.

  • 04 Is there anything I should absolutely NOT ask?

Avoid asking questions that are easily answered by a quick search of the company website or questions solely focused on benefits, salary, or vacation time at this stage. These types of questions signal a lack of preparation or a self-serving focus, detracting from your professional image. Your final questions should reinforce your value, not raise doubts.

I also tell people to avoid asking questions that are overly generic or could apply to any company, like "What do you like most about working here?" While it's okay to build rapport, your final questions are for demonstrating strategic fit. Save the generic questions for networking calls, not the interview's closing act. Most prep advice is useless because it tells you to ask what you want to know, not what *they* need to hear. Your Baldwin Blueprint helps you identify their core needs directly from the job posting, so your questions can be laser focused on those.

  • 05

How do I ask a question that makes me stand out?

Ask a question that directly references a detail from your resume or the job posting, then connect it to a strategic signal or an Account Map insight from your Baldwin Blueprint. This type of question makes you memorable because it's specific, personalized, and demonstrates deep preparation. It shows you've done your homework and understand their world.

For example, if your resume highlights a specific project management success, and the job posting emphasizes improving project timelines, you could ask: "Given my experience leading the [Project Name] initiative, where we reduced delivery times by 15%, what are the current bottlenecks in your project pipeline that you envision this role specifically addressing?" This isn't just a question; it's a subtle reminder of your relevant achievements and a direct offer to solve their problems. Itâs about making a direct link between your past success and their future needs. This is the difference between a good candidate and the one they can't stop thinking about.

Worked example

  • 30/60/90 line

Before

What are the biggest challenges this role will face?

After

Based on my research into your Q3 earnings call, where you discussed streamlining supply chain logistics, what specific data sources or key stakeholders would be critical for me to engage with in my first 30 days to begin mapping out an optimization strategy for that area?

Interview Questions: Impact vs. Inquiry What most people do What actually works Ask about team culture or company benefits. Ask how your specific skills solve their problems. Ask for a job description summary. Refer to a specific point from the job posting or their website. Ask generic questions from a list. Craft questions that lead to an offer, not just information. Ask questions that show you're curious. Ask questions that show you're already contributing. Wait to be told what to do. Propose how you'll make an immediate impact.

The takeaways

  • 01Ask questions that solve problems, not just gather info.
  • 02Reference the job posting and your resume directly.
  • 03Frame questions to reveal your strategic value.
  • 04Use your 30/60/90 plan to guide your questions.

Questions people ask

What if I don't have any questions left after our conversation?

It's rare that you won't have any questions if you're truly engaged, but if it happens, you can say, "You've been incredibly thorough, and I feel I have a strong understanding of the role and team. I'm confident I can contribute significantly." Then, pivot to reiterating your interest and fit. You can also offer to follow up if new questions arise.

Is this just a fancy cover letter? What does Baldwin Blueprint actually do?

No, it's much more. A cover letter is static. Baldwin Blueprint turns the actual job posting and your resume into a living 12 page strategic Blueprint you walk in with. It includes an Impact Memo, an Account Map, Strategic Signals, an Experience Accelerator, and a 30/60/90 day plan tailored specifically to that role. It's built from the actual posting, and the first draft is free, no card required. It gives you concrete, specific content for every stage of the interview, including the questions you ask.

How many questions should I ask?

Aim for 2 to 3 strong, impactful questions. Quality over quantity. You want to leave them thinking about your insights, not just how many questions you had. If your questions are strategic and well-researched, you won't need many to make a lasting impression. Focus on the ones that highlight your unique value and understanding of the role.

What if the interviewer seems rushed?

If they seem rushed, acknowledge it respectfully. "I know we're short on time, so I'll just ask one key question: based on our conversation, what's the single most critical challenge this role needs to solve in the first 6 months?" This shows you're observant and considerate, while still landing a powerful, focused question. It's about adapting to the situation while still making your point.

What does 'fast-paced environment' actually mean for my day to day?

By Chris Baldwin

SHORT ANSWERTranslate 'fast-paced environment' as a warning that the company lacks clear processes, has shifting priorities, and expects you to manage your own chaos. It means you must make decisions with incomplete data and execute tasks quickly without waiting for permission or perfect instructions.

Seeing 'fast-paced environment' in a job posting usually makes your stomach drop because it sounds like a recipe for instant burnout. I will show you how to decode this phrase so you can spot the warning signs and prove you can handle the actual work. You will walk away with a concrete strategy to turn this vague requirement into your biggest unfair advantage.

They need I can prove Scale a team Cut churn Ship fast Hired 9 Cut it 22% Weekly ships line them up first

FIG. 02Before I write a single line, I draw two columns: what they need on the left, what I can prove on the right. Then I draw lines connecting them. The gaps that have no line tell me exactly what to address in the cover note.

  • 01 Is 'fast-paced' just code for understaffed and chaotic?

A fast-paced environment means the company has more work than people and lacks the structured systems to manage the daily overflow. It is often a direct signal that priorities change weekly, resources are scarce, and you will be expected to self-manage through constant operational friction.

I see this constantly. Startups use this phrase because they are building the plane while flying it, while larger companies use it to excuse their broken internal processes. It is a structural reality.

You need to ask the hiring manager how they prioritize projects when everything is labeled urgent. Ask them to describe a week when a major goal shifted mid-flight.

  • 02

How do I prove I can thrive in this kind of chaos?

Prove your capability by sharing specific examples of times you managed competing deadlines, made decisions with limited data, and built your own templates to survive. You must demonstrate that you do not need a perfect manual to execute your daily tasks and deliver real results.

Most prep advice is useless because it tells you to say you love speed. Do not do that. Instead, give them a concrete example, like how you managed a sudden product launch delay by shifting your team's focus to customer documentation.

For example, a customer support lead could explain how they handled a forty percent spike in tickets without extra budget by building a temporary automated triage system.

fifty generic five sharp ones weight wins, not stack height

FIG. 03I weighed fifty generic applications against five sharp ones, and the five tailored to the role still tipped the scale. Fit carries more than sheer count. Build this for your role.Paste a real posting, get the 12 page plan. First draft free.Start free

  • 03 What are the red flags to watch out for in the interview?

Red flags appear when interviewers cannot define what success looks like in the first ninety days or when they brag about working late nights. If they describe the culture as a family that works hard and plays hard, expect uncompensated overtime and poor boundaries.

I want you to listen to their vocabulary. If they use words like firefighting or wearing many hats too often, run.

Here is your honest caveat. A strategic blueprint can prepare you for the interview, but it cannot fix a toxic boss once you take the job. You must use the interview to screen them just as much as they screen you.

  • 04

How does a 30/60/90 day plan help me address this?

A structured plan addresses this by showing the hiring manager you know how to onboard yourself without draining their limited time or resources. It proves you can identify quick wins, map out key stakeholders, and establish your own workflow within your first month on the job.

This is where the Baldwin Blueprint comes in. When you walk in with a 30/60/90 day plan built from their actual job posting, you show them you do not need hand-holding.

You are telling them, I see the chaos, and here is exactly how I plan to organize my first ninety days to relieve your pressure.

Worked example

  • STAR answer

Before

I work really well under pressure and I am used to fast-paced environments where things change quickly.

After

When our main supplier shut down with zero notice, I did not wait for leadership to act. I built a temporary tracking sheet, sourced three local backup vendors within forty-eight hours, and kept our production line running without a single hour of downtime.

How to handle 'fast-paced' in your application What most people do What actually works Write generic resume bullets about multitasking Quantify how you managed shifting priorities and tight deadlines Nod and say you love a challenge during the interview Ask how the team handles resource constraints and shifting goals Wait for the company to train you on their systems Present a 30/60/90 day plan showing how you will onboard yourself

The takeaways

  • 01Fast-paced usually means shifting priorities and limited resources.
  • 02Prove you can self-manage with concrete, quantified examples.
  • 03Use the interview to screen for toxic, disorganized environments.
  • 04A 30/60/90 day plan shows you do not need hand-holding.

Questions people ask

Does fast-paced always mean I will have to work overtime?

Not always, but it usually means your working hours will be intense and highly focused. It often points to poor project management, which can bleed into your personal time if you do not set firm boundaries early in your tenure.

Is Baldwin Blueprint just a fancy cover letter generator?

No, it is a comprehensive twelve page strategic document that includes an Impact Memo, Account Map, and 30/60/90 day plan. It does not write generic cover letters. It analyzes the actual job posting to build a concrete execution plan you can use in your interview.

How do I ask about work-life balance without sounding lazy?

Ask how the team prioritizes work when everything is urgent. A good manager will explain their triage process, while a bad one will tell you that everything simply has to get done, which is your cue to walk away.

Notre offre

Au sein de la direction International et Opérations (DIO), rattaché au second de cuisine, le cuisinier a pour mission de réaliser la production alimentaire d'un restaurant collectif et de ces prestations particulières.


Vos missions au quotidien

- Réaliser les préparations culinaires selon les fiches techniques

- Assurer les cuissons le dressage et la mise en valeur des plats

- Assurer le nettoyage et l'entretien du poste de travail et du matériel

- Travailler en coordination avec le reste de l'équipe du RF

- Préparer les produits et mettre en place les matériels de cuisine

- S'assurer de la qualité des denrées fournies

- Produire, valoriser et vérifier (goût, qualité, présentation) les préparations

- Repérer et signaler les dysfonctionnements

- Veiller au bon déroulement du service dans les différents espaces de restauration

- Assurer l'accueil des convives et la gestion des enregistrements des passages viales caisses JES pour les 3 services


Votre profil
Le candidat est de nationalité française et/ou ressortissant européen.
Etablissement soumis à enquête administrative.

Votre parcours

Formation CAP/BEP restauration et/ou niveau équivalent acquis par une expérience d'au moins 2 ans dans le domaine.


Les savoir-être partagés par tous les collaborateurs de l'EdA

Esprit d'équipe, sens du service, discrétion, implication, agilité, éthique, communication, initiative


Nos propositions

Poste à pourvoir sur des enceintes militaires françaises.

Rattaché au second de cuisine.

Respect des règles de sécurité édictées par l'autorité militaire, notamment les conditions de sortie.

Logement fourni (nuitée et petit déjeuner), type appart hôtel.

Poste de contact, varié, nécessitant d'être apte à travailler en autonomie aussi bien qu'en équipe.

L'engagement au côté des forces armées françaises nous permet de donner du sens à nos actions et de nous accomplir au quotidien. C'est l'opportunité de mettre nos expertises et notre créativité au service de projets dimensionnants.

Nous rejoindre c'est intégrer un collectif où l'humain reste au centre des attentions, qu'il soit client ou collaborateur. Nous avons la conviction que le service indéfectible que nous devons à nos prescripteurs ne peut être garanti que par la qualité de l'environnement que nous proposons à nos équipes.

A la jonction des univers militaire et civil, l'EdA est riche d'une culture de mixité.
En postulant chez nous, ne vous posez pas d'autre question que celle de savoir si vous partagez nos valeurs et ambitions.
Au-delà de votre expertise, nous recherchons les qualités qui font la force de nos équipes : éthique, implication, audace, rigueur, empathie et créativité.

Ce poste est ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap.

·     Et stærkt fagligt miljø – du arbejder sammen med erfarne specialister og får kolleger, der gerne deler deres viden.

·     Opgaver med variation – du møder forskellige køretøjer, opbygninger og tekniske problemstillinger.

·     Mulighed for at blive endnu dygtigere – vi tilbyder relevante kurser og efteruddannelse.

·     Ordentlige rammer – gode arbejdsforhold, hjælpsomme kolleger og en uformel omgangstone.

·     En arbejdsplads med retning – du bliver en del af en landsdækkende specialistvirksomhed med stolte håndværkstraditioner og stor efterspørgsel.


 

Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Du har en faglig baggrund som mekaniker eller reparatør – eller solid erfaring, der giver dig et stærkt teknisk fundament. Du arbejder selvstændigt, men trives også i et team, hvor man lykkes sammen.

Vi forestiller os desuden, at du:

·     har erfaring med mekanisk montage, fejlfinding og service

·     har flair for hydraulik og el – eller lyst til at lære mere

·     er kvalitetsbevidst og følger opgaven helt til dørs

·     er fleksibel, serviceminded og har forståelse for kundens behov

·     har kørekort til kategori B

Du behøver ikke kunne alt fra første dag. Det vigtigste er, at du har et godt mekanisk fundament, tager ansvar for kvaliteten og har lyst til at udvikle dig sammen med os.

Om SAWO

SAWO leverer, opbygger og servicerer kraner, hejs, ladopbygninger, lifte og specialudstyr til transport- og entreprenørbranchen. Med værksteder og servicepunkter over hele Danmark hjælper vi kunderne hurtigt og kompetent – fra rådgivning og specialopbygning til service, reparation og reservedele.

Bag hver løsning står mennesker med høj faglighed og respekt for godt håndværk. Det gælder også dig, hvis du bliver vores nye kollega.

jobs.title: Skal du have en plads bag rattet i en af Aarhus’ ambulancer?
jobs.description:
Præhospitalet søger lige nu en ny kollega, der har lyst til at være en del den regionale ambulancetjeneste i Aarhusområdet. 

Du får hjemmebase på Præhospitalets største base på Bautavej i Aarhus V, hvor du bliver en del af et stærkt, kollegialt fællesskab.

Vi har en ledig stilling i DAN-vagtrul til besættelse 1. november 2026, eller efter aftale. Her får du 12-timers vagter i rækkefølgen 6-18, 11-23, 18-06 og 5 fridøgn

Hvem er du?
Du er uddannet paramediciner eller ambulancebehandler med autorisation. Du skal være fagligt velfunderet og opdateret inden for dit felt, og du skal have vist, at du tager ansvar for egen faglig udvikling og uddannelse.

Du kommer til at indgå i en organisation, der har fokus på både at løse de daglige opgaver, og hvor opgaverne er under fortsat udvikling. Vi håber, at du vil bidrage til en konstruktiv og løsningsorienteret samarbejdskultur – på tværs af faggrupper og organisatoriske tilhørsforhold. Der vil således blive lagt vægt på dine evner til at samarbejde og til at bidrage til et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab i ambulancerne og i Præhospitalet som helhed. 

Du skal have kørekort kategori B og C. 

Der indhentes straffeattest og børneattest.

Din nye arbejdsplads
Præhospitalet har ansvaret for det præhospitale område i Region Midtjylland, og vores hovedopgave og vision er ”at sikre rette hjælp i rette tid til alle patienter”. Præhospitalet har som de øvrige hospitaler i regionen både drifts-, behandlings-, uddannelses-, kvalitetssikrings- og forskningsmæssige opgaver. I Præhospitalet møder du kolleger med mange forskellige fagligheder, og fælles for alle er, at vi stræber efter at gøre det bedste for patienterne.

I Præhospitalet lægger vi vægt på høj faglighed, uddannelse og udvikling. Det håber vi også, at du gør, for kompetencevedligehold og efteruddannelse bliver en lige så fast del af dit arbejde som udrykning og behandling af patienter. Derfor skal du også selv have et ønske om at styrke din egen faglighed og udvikling. Det gør du selvfølgelig ikke alene – for vi hjælper og støtter hinanden, og der er kort vej fra medarbejdere til ledelsen. Vi vil gerne være en attraktiv og rummelig arbejdsplads, og du skal kunne se dig selv som en del af et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab og meget gerne bidrage til det fælles arbejdsmiljø. 

Du bliver ansat i Præhospitalets afdeling for ambulancer og akutlægebiler. Afdelingen ledes af en afdelingsledelse, som består af en ambulancechef og en cheflæge, samt en funktionsledelse bestående af 11 funktionsledere. Funktionslederne varetager personaleledelsen af ambulancepersonalet samt den daglige drift.

Du kommer til at referere til funktionsleder Morten Herlev.

Løn og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til overenskomst med FOA.


Yderligere information
Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at skrive eller ringe til:
Funktionsleder Morten Herlev
Mail: M.Herlev@rm.dk 
Tlf.: 51152151

Du kan finde flere oplysninger om Præhospitalet her Præhospitalet

Sådan søger du
Du søger nemt stillingen via linket "send ansøgning" nederst på siden. Her bliver du bedt om at udfylde nogle oplysninger om dig selv (navn, adresse mv.) samt vedhæfte en motiveret ansøgning og et opdateret CV.

Ansættelsesproces
Der er ansøgningsfrist d. 24. august 2026. Samtaler afholdes d. 26. august på Olof Palmes Allé i Aarhus N.

 

 


Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

jobs.title: Go-to-Market Responsible
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy turning product direction into commercially successful go-to-market plans? Are you motivated by bringing collections to life across retail, e-commerce and other consumer-facing channels? And do you thrive in the role that connects Product, Brand Identity and commercial execution?

Then you may be the Go-to-Market Responsible we are looking for.

YOUR TEAM
You'll join our E-Commerce & DTC Marketing team, where we bring our collections to market across retail, e-commerce and other consumer-facing channels. As our GTM Responsible, you'll work closely with specialists across CRM, Media, Retail & E-Commerce while partnering with Product, Brand Identity and B2B Communications to ensure every launch is successfully planned and delivered.

YOUR ROLE
As our Go-to-Market Responsible, you'll own the annual DTC go-to-market plan, translating product direction into commercially successful market launches. Working closely with Product, Brand Identity and key business stakeholders, you'll shape go-to-market plans that connect product direction with commercial execution across retail, e-commerce and other consumer-facing channels.
You'll ensure product direction is translated into clear plans, strong cross-functional collaboration and successful execution, bringing launches to market on time and supporting both revenue growth and brand awareness.

Your key responsibilities include:

  • Developing and driving the annual DTC go-to-market plan

  • Translating product direction into campaign and rollout plans

  • Planning and coordinating market launches across retail, e-commerce and other consumer-facing channels

  • Driving timelines and cross-functional execution from planning to launch

  • Coordinating stakeholders across Product, Brand Identity and B2B Communications

  • Using commercial performance and brand insights to optimize future go-to-market planning.

YOUR BENEFITS
This is a role for someone who enjoys making things happen. You'll work in a fast-moving environment where every collection presents new opportunities to improve, simplify and strengthen the way we go to market. If you're motivated by creating clarity, driving progress and seeing your work make a commercial difference, you'll find plenty of room to do so here.

YOUR PROFILE
You're at your best when bringing people, plans and commercial priorities together. You enjoy working across functions, balancing different perspectives and turning product direction into successful go-to-market activities.
Whether your background is in fashion or another consumer-focused industry, what matters to us is that you understand what it takes to create relevant consumer communication that resonates with end consumers.

In addition, we’re looking for someone who brings the following:

  • A relevant degree in Marketing, Communication or a related field

  • 4+ years of experience within DTC marketing, campaign planning or go-to-market planning

  • Experience planning and executing campaigns across multiple consumer-facing channels, including media planning and rollout.

  • Strong project management skills with experience coordinating cross-functional initiatives

  • A commercial, analytical and KPI-driven mindset, using data and insights to support decision-making.

WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOU
If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Eileen Elbers at +45 52 15 40 73. Otherwise, please send us your application and CV as soon as possible and no later than 11 September 2026. We review candidates on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to take down the ad when we find the right candidate.

LOCATION: Brande, Denmark.

jobs.title: Senior Lead Project Manager for IT Technology project
jobs.description:
Are you a very experienced Project Manager with a passion for driving big and complex projects involving software development together with a big global vendor? Do you enjoy leading highly skilled teams in a dynamic and international environment? Then you may be our new Senior Lead Project Manager.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition

Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. Join Nordic RCC and contribute to ensuring a secure and sustainable energy in the future.

Job description

Nordic RCC seeks a skilled and experienced Project Manager to drive an IT project with many internal and external stakeholders, several deliverables and milestones, delivered within agreed go-live dates.

You will be responsible for coordinating all aspects of the project as scoping, planning, execution and delivery. Working closely together with a big global vendor and senior stakeholders across Nordic RCC, you will ensure seamless collaboration and a transparent strong approach to project management.

You will guide the project team incl. project managers through strong project risk management and planning, dependencies to other projects, financial control, stakeholder alignment, and progress monitoring in close collaboration with the internal and external Steercos, ensuring alignment with Nordic RCC’s goals.

Your primary tasks and areas of responsibility:

  • Facilitate a strong collaboration and communication among program/project stakeholders from the different departments in the organization, the vendor's project organisation and the internal/external Steercos

  • In control of budget, forecast and monthly financial updates, incl. alignment with financial milestones from vendor

  • In control of project scope, resource needs according to project plan, manage project risks continuously through the project lifetime in close collaboration with vendor, internal project managers and the Steercos

  • In control of develop, coordinate, communicate and execute project plans with clear milestones and deadlines, ensuring to deliver all milestones on time in close collaboration with both vendor and Nordic RCC

  • Monitor program/project progress, assess performance, and report outcomes to key stakeholders/Steercos by monthly meetings and reporting to Leadership team in Nordic RCC

  • Lead a strong transition from each go-live to operational phase, ensuring an organized handover to line organization for the different deliverables

  • Use best practices and processes, e.g. Stage Gate Model, Governance model, Resource management, Project Risk Management etc. to provide the optimal guidance to cross-functional project teams throughout the project lifecycle with focus on balancing quality, efficiency, deliver on time and financials

Required skills and experience

The ideal candidate holds a BA or MA in IT with strong project or program management experience working with software development in an IT project in collaboration with a big global vendor.

Key skills include:

  • Strong drive and passion for project management, ensuring the project teams deliver on time in expected quality/scope and in control of finance

  • Strong organizational, planning and time management skills

  • Proven track record in managing senior stakeholder expectations and leading cross-functional teams in collaboration with an IT vendor

  • Experience in communicating both big-picture objectives and project details, ensuring all project managers/team members understand their roles and contributions

  • Demonstrated ability to identify challenges early and proactively drive deliverables in collaboration with vendor and project teams

  • At least 10 years of relevant experience in IT project management with a global vendor

  • Relevant project management certificates and e.g., relevant change management certificates

  • Full professional proficiency in English

Employment conditions

You will join a company of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently more than 24 nationalities with more than 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

 Your daily workplace will be in our newly furnished office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We are offering workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance including the possibility for working from home some of your worktime. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note, that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined. 

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) on https://www.globesearch.dk/jobs/8221470 . We may conduct interviews on a continuous basis.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system. 

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

jobs.title: JP Dynasty ApS søger en Group Kitchen Manager
jobs.description:
JP Dynasty ApS er en asiatisk restaurantgruppe med base i København og driver flere brands og restauranter.

I takt med at koncernen fortsætter med at vokse, søger vi en erfaren Group Kitchen Manager / køkkenchef med ansvar for flere restauranter, som kan sikre en ensartet og effektiv køkkendrift på tværs af vores lokationer.

Primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Overordnet ansvar for den daglige køkkendrift på tværs af flere restauranter

  • Regelmæssige besøg og kontrol af køkkenerne for at sikre ensartet kvalitet, hastighed, hygiejne og driftsstandard

  • Udarbejde, forbedre og implementere SOP'er og standardiserede arbejdsprocedurer

  • Lede, træne og støtte Kitchen Managers og køkkenteams

  • Sikre overholdelse af fødevaresikkerhed, hygiejne og HACCP

  • Kontrollere vareforbrug, lønomkostninger, madspild og køkkeneffektivitet

  • Overvåge lager, varebestilling, lageroptælling, FIFO og råvareforbrug

  • Anvende lager- og managementsystemer til at identificere driftsmæssige og økonomiske problemer

  • Koordinere tæt med centralkøkken, indkøb, restaurantchefer og administration

  • Ansvar for implementering af nye retter fra test og standardisering til lancering i restauranterne

  • Tilpasse produktion, forberedelse og bemanding efter omsætning og driftsbehov

  • Håndtere akutte driftsproblemer og udvikle langsigtede løsninger

  • Deltage i åbning af nye restauranter, herunder køkkenopsætning, arbejdsprocesser og medarbejdertræning

  • Rapportere regelmæssigt til ledelsen om køkkendrift, problemer og forbedringstiltag

Vi forventer, at du

  • Kan kinesisk og engelsk flydende, både mundtligt og skriftligt

  • Har erfaring med køkkenledelse fra en restaurantkæde, flere restauranter eller centralkøkken

  • Har erfaring med ledelse af Kitchen Managers, kokke og køkkenmedarbejdere

  • Kan tage selvstændigt ansvar for flere restauranter og ikke kun ét køkken

  • Har solidt kendskab til fødevaresikkerhed, køkkenhygiejne og HACCP

  • Har erfaring med kontrol af food cost, lager, madspild og løneffektivitet

  • Kan anvende Microsoft Office, Google Workspace eller tilsvarende kontorsoftware

  • Kan arbejde med lagerstyrings-, indkøbs- eller restaurantmanagementsystemer

  • Har god talforståelse og kan identificere problemer gennem rapporter og data

  • Har erfaring med at udarbejde og implementere SOP'er

  • Har stærke ledelses-, kommunikations- og træningsevner

  • Kan håndtere flere driftsmæssige udfordringer samtidigt i et travlt miljø

  • Er ansvarlig, proaktiv og løsningsorienteret

  • Kan arbejde i weekender og har fleksible arbejdstider efter restaurantdriftens behov

Det er en fordel, hvis du har

  • Erfaring fra asiatiske restauranter, japansk eller kinesisk køkken eller fast-casual-kæder

  • Erfaring fra centralkøkken eller fødevareproduktion

  • Erfaring med åbning af nye restauranter

  • Erfaring med menuudvikling og standardisering af produkter

  • Erfaring fra en restaurantgruppe med flere brands

  • Kendskab til danske regler om fødevaresikkerhed og restaurationsdrift

  • Tidligere erfaring fra restaurationsbranchen i Danmark

Vi tilbyder

  • En central lederstilling i en voksende asiatisk restaurantgruppe i København

  • Ansvar på tværs af flere brands og restauranter

  • Stor indflydelse på den daglige drift og gode udviklingsmuligheder

  • Mulighed for at deltage i nye restaurantåbninger, produktudvikling og udvikling af centralkøkken

  • Løn efter erfaring og kvalifikationer

Arbejdssted: København, med regelmæssigt arbejde på tværs af vores restauranter
Virksomhed: JP Dynasty ApS
Stilling: Group Kitchen Manager / Køkkenchef med ansvar for flere restauranter
Ansættelse: Fuldtid

JP Dynasty ApS is Hiring: Group Kitchen Manager

JP Dynasty ApS is a Copenhagen-based Asian restaurant group operating multiple brands and locations.

As our group continues to grow, we are looking for an experienced Group Kitchen Manager / Multi-Unit Kitchen Manager to oversee kitchen operations across several locations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily kitchen operations across multiple restaurant locations

jobs.title: Chaufførafløser - STARK Næstved
jobs.description:
Vil du sikre effektiv varelevering og være del af et professionelt fællesskab, der bygger fremtiden ved at hjælpe andre med at bygge deres? STARK Næstved søger en engageret Chauffør-afløser til at forme vores fremtid som Danmarks førende distributør af byggematerialer.

 

Din rolle som Chauffør

Du bliver en del af lager- og logistikken i STARK Næstved, hvor vi er 18 dedikerede medarbejdere, som målrettet arbejder med distribution og håndtering af byggematerialer til professionelle håndværkere, virksomheder og private. Som en del af lager- og logistikteamet hos STARK Næstved vil du:

  • Levere varer med STARK lastvogn med kran (8-25 TM), herunder læsse og aflæsse med truck. Dette medfører at du har kørekort til lastbil (C), krancertifikat (D), truckcertifikat og EU-kvalifikationsbevis.

  • Sikre god service ved levering til både store byggeprojekter og private kunder.

  • Repræsentere STARK i lokalområdet.

  • Overholde sikkerhedsstandarder og kvalitetskrav.

  • Samarbejde tæt med kollegaer for optimal planlægning og rettidig levering.

Vores nye Chauffør

Du vil blive en del af at sikre, at vi efterlever vores værdier. Det betyder, at vi udviser ordentlighed, passion og stolthed overfor vores kunder, samarbejdspartnere, leverandører og kollegaer i det daglige arbejde. For at trives i rollen som Chauffør er det vigtigt, at du:

  • Er stabil og tager ejerskab over dine opgaver og lægger vægt på det gode samarbejde

  • Er dygtig til at organisere og planlægge og kan møde kunderne med en positiv og venlig tilgang.

Den rette kandidat, for os, kan både være faglært og ufaglært. Selvom erfaring med distributionskørsel og branchekendskab kan være nyttigt, er det ikke en forudsætning. Det vigtigste for os er din interesse og motivation for at arbejde med transport, kundeservice og at blive en del af STARK holdet.

Bliv en del af STARK holdet

Hos STARK ser vi mangfoldighed som en værdifuld egenskab, og vores medarbejderes bidrag er nøglen til vores fremgang. Vi opfordrer derfor alle, som kan se sig selv i stillingen til at søge. Udover gode arbejdsforhold og ansættelse på overenskomst har vi personalepolitikker, der tilgodeser medarbejderen i tråd med STARKs værdi om ordentlighed.

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling på 37 og vi håber, at du kan starte snarest eller senest d. 1. Oktober 2026.

Send os dit CV med en kort beskrivelse af din motivation for at søge stillingen hos STARK Næstved via linket. Vi inviterer til samtaler løbende og afslutter processen, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Har du spørgsmål jobbet, eller er du nysgerrig på at vide mere om STARK Næstved som din kommende arbejdsplads, er du velkommen til at kontakte Driftschef René Boss Selliah på telefon +45 2892 0788.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

 

___________________________________________________

Om STARK

STARK er Danmarks største forhandler og distributør af byggematerialer med flere end 80 forretninger i Danmark og Grønland. STARK tilbyder også faglig rådgivning og en lang række services til både entreprenører og professionelle håndværkere. Virksomheden beskæftiger over 2.400 medarbejdere og er en del af STARK Group, der med flere end 18.500 medarbejdere og 1.050 forretninger og distributionscentre i Norden, Storbritannien, Tyskland og Østrig, er en førende leverandør af byggematerialer i Europa.

STARK Group har SBTi-godkendte net zero klimamål for 2050. Koncernen har underskrevet FN’s Global Compact principper og er anerkendt af EcoVadis med en Platinum-rating for sin bæredygtighedsindsats. 

Vi bygger fremtiden ved at hjælpe andre med at bygge deres.

jobs.title: Research Assistant in Regenerative Medicine
jobs.description:
A position as a full-time research assistant is vacant in the lab of Dr. Srustidhar Das, at the Department of Clinical Research and at the Research Unit of Inflammation Research, Department of Molecular Medicine, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to one year with the possibility of extension and/or continuing further as a PhD student, subject to funding and fulfilment of SDU's PhD admission requirements.

Job description

The position primarily consists of research within tissue regeneration, epithelial biology and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), with limited research-based teaching or supervision activities where relevant. The research assistant will join a translational research programme that aims to understand how inflammation reshapes the intestinal epithelium and its surrounding tissue niche, and how these changes can be therapeutically targeted to restore safe and durable mucosal healing.

The position will suit a highly motivated candidate with a strong interest in mucosal biology, epithelial regeneration, organoid models, immune-stromal-epithelial interactions, single-cell and spatial technologies, and clinically oriented biomedical research. The successful candidate will work at the interface of experimental biology, translational medicine and omics-based research.

Research environment

The research assistant will be embedded in a dynamic and highly collaborative research environment spanning the Institute for Molecular Medicine and the Department of Clinical Research at SDU. The project benefits from close interactions among basic scientists, clinicians, bioinformaticians and translational researchers, with strong links to Odense University Hospital and access to patient-derived material, advanced disease models and state-of-the-art molecular technologies.

The environment provides excellent opportunities to develop practical and analytical skills in experimental and translational biomedicine, contribute to clinically relevant discoveries in IBD and tissue regeneration, and prepare for a potential subsequent PhD project.

Research project

The project investigates how prior inflammation leaves a lasting memory in the intestinal epithelium and its surrounding tissue niche, and how this memory affects mucosal healing in IBD. The research assistant will help establish and apply experimental models based on patient-derived intestinal biopsies, organoids, fibroblasts and immune-cell co-cultures to study epithelial regeneration in health and disease.

The work will also support the generation and functional validation of findings from single-cell and spatial approaches, including single-cell RNA sequencing, single-cell chromatin accessibility analysis, spatial transcriptomics and spatial epigenomics. Depending on experience and project needs, the research assistant may contribute to CRISPR-based genetic engineering of patient-derived organoids.

Key responsibilities

  • Establish, maintain and experimentally manipulate patient-derived intestinal organoids and relevant co-culture systems involving fibroblasts and immune cells.

  • Design and perform functional assays to assess epithelial regeneration, inflammatory responses, barrier function and cell-state plasticity.

  • Apply molecular and cellular methods such as qPCR, immunostaining, microscopy, flow cytometry, ELISA-based assays and related techniques.

  • Support sample preparation and experimental workflows for single-cell and spatial transcriptomic or epigenomic studies.

  • Contribute to CRISPR-based genetic engineering and functional validation of candidate pathways, depending on prior experience.

  • Work with patient-derived material in close collaboration with clinicians, bioinformaticians and translational researchers.

  • Maintain accurate experimental records, analyse and document results, and contribute to protocol development and optimisation.

  • Present results at group meetings and contribute to scientific reports, manuscripts, conferences, teaching and collaborative activities where relevant.

Expectations of qualifications 

The applicant is expected to hold a relevant master's degree or equivalent qualification in molecular biology, biomedicine, immunology, cell biology, biotechnology, medicine, bioinformatics or a closely related discipline.

Essential qualifications

  • A strong interest in mucosal biology, tissue regeneration, epithelial biology, inflammatory disease and translational biomedical research.

  • Hands-on experience with mammalian cell culture, molecular biology, primary cells, organoids, immunology, epithelial biology, inflammation research or related experimental systems.

  • Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

  • A structured, curious and technically careful working style, with the ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.

  • Good organisational skills and a commitment to reproducible research, careful documentation and responsible handling of research data and biological material.

Desirable qualifications

  • Experience with intestinal organoids, patient-derived material, immune-cell culture, fibroblast culture or epithelial-stromal-immune co-culture models.

  • Familiarity with qPCR, immunostaining, confocal or advanced microscopy, flow cytometry, ELISA or MSD assays, and CRISPR-based genetic engineering.

  • Experience with, or a strong interest in learning, single-cell RNA sequencing, ATAC-seq, spatial transcriptomics, spatial epigenomics or computational analysis of omics datasets.

  • Interest in developing and optimising experimental models that connect mechanistic biology with clinically relevant questions in IBD and mucosal healing.

  • Previous experience with bioinformatics, statistics or image analysis will be considered an advantage but is not essential.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision –We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information please contact 

Srustidhar Das
Department of Clinical Research and Department of Molecular Medicine
University of Southern Denmark (SDU)
Tel.: +45 71504339
E-mail: srudas@health.sdu.dk

Application deadline

September 15, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET/CEST).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations). 

The position as research assistant is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed research assistant allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated. 

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.   

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of master’s degree)

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Influencer Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
At Aftershoot, we're building a global community of photographers who spend less time behind their screens and more time behind the lens. Every feature we create, every update we ship, is designed to make post-processing easier, faster, and smarter for photographers around the world.

From culling to editing to retouching. Our AI tools do all the heavy lifting, so photographers can focus on what they do best: capturing moments, telling stories, and creating magic.

We're a fast-growing, passionate team backed by 100K+ active users globally. Double-digit ARR in less than 4 years, amazing investors and a team who truly believe in our mission.

Our mission is clear: Become the default companion for every photographer in the world. If you care deeply about building meaningful products, working with curious and driven teammates, and being part of a team that genuinely loves what they do, we'd love to meet you.

Let's create the future of AI in photography, together.

About the Role

This is a function-owner role, not an execution role.

Aftershoot already invests seven figures a year into creators, and creator-led content is one of the biggest drivers of how photographers discover us. What we don't yet have is someone who owns it end to end: who decides where the money goes, which creators earn a renewal, what the content should actually say, and how we prove any of it worked.

That's you. You'll set the strategy, own the budget, build the partner roster, and lead a small team of executives who handle day-to-day outreach and campaign management. Most of our creators are based in the US, so you'll be working across US time zones on a regular basis.

You'll come in with a clear mandate: make the same spend go three times further, or deliver the same results for meaningfully less. Both are good answers.

What You'll Do

â¢ Own Aftershoot's global influencer and creator marketing strategy end to end, with the US as the primary market.

â¢ Own the annual creator budget: allocate it, defend it, sunset what isn't working, and double down on what is.

â¢ Build and maintain the partner roster across YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok, spanning photography, creative-tools, and tech audiences.â¢ Move the program from one-off sponsored posts toward recurring partnerships, ambassador structures, and long-term creator relationships.

â¢ Build the measurement layer: attribution, incrementality, cost per trial and per paid conversion by creator, so renewal decisions are made on evidence rather than instinct.

â¢ Negotiate rates, deliverables, exclusivity, and usage rights, including whitelisting so strong creator content can be repurposed into paid media.

â¢ Get content actually shipped: briefing creators, holding them to timelines, and getting the work over the line when it slips.

â¢ Hire, manage, and coach a team of 2â3 Influencer Marketing Executives.

â¢ Work closely with Growth, Content, Product Marketing, and Design so creator content plugs into the wider marketing engine rather than running beside it.

â¢ Plan and run creator activity around peak moments like Black Friday and major product launches.

â¢ Explore adjacent channels where they make sense: affiliate, community, events, and podcast partnerships.

What You'll Bring

â¢ 5â8 years in influencer, creator, or partnerships marketing, at an agency or in-house, with at least 2 of those years setting strategy rather than only executing campaigns.

â¢ Direct experience managing a meaningful creator budget, and the ability to walk us through how you spent it and what you got back.

â¢ Experience working with US or international creators, and comfort operating across time zones.

â¢ Excellent spoken and written English. Much of this job is video calls and negotiation with US-based creators, so you need to be clear, natural, and persuasive live.

â¢ Real negotiation instincts. Paying a creator is the beginning of the relationship, not the end of it, and getting good work out of a partner takes persistence and charm in equal measure.

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer
jobs.description:
About us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. Weâre proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role

We are seeking a Lead Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product vision, systems thinking and influence. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or similarly sophisticated product experiences, and are ready to shape product direction, design standards and team culture across one or more product pillars.

As a lead individual contributor, you will partner deeply with product and engineering leaders, mentor other designers and help teams define and improve strategically important product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and long-term product strategy to clear, useful and highly polished product design.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate an extraordinarily high bar for design craft and visual sophistication, and to raise that bar for the teams around them. You should care deeply about hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, interaction quality, usability, accessibility and the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent at scale. We want candidates who can ship truly world-class product design.

Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

What You Can Expect

  • Autonomy to shape design direction across one or more strategically important product pillars.

  • Meaningful influence with product, engineering and senior leadership on product quality, customer outcomes and roadmap direction.

  • The opportunity to raise the design bar across multiple teams through critique, standards, mentorship and systems thinking.

  • Partnership with ambitious product, engineering, data and design peers who value clarity, speed, craft and customer outcomes.

  • A craft-forward design culture where lead designers help strengthen design practice, improve team rituals and grow other designers.

  • A 100% remote environment where distributed collaboration is normal. Employees in all geographies are expected to be flexible and thoughtful about working hours so US- and India-based colleagues can collaborate effectively.

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or other complex digital product environments is highly valuable.

  • An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution.

  • Proven experience leading data-informed product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing.

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.

  • Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams.

  • Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.

  • Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.

  • Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery.

  • Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps.

  • Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes.

  • Influence leadership decisions through customer empathy, data synthesis, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale.

  • Drive design quality reviews and set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency and design system alignment.

  • Raise the quality of multiple teams by mentoring designers, improving critique, strengthening shared patterns and making standards easier to adopt.

  • Define and socialize metrics for design quality and impact, such as usability signals, accessibility compliance, task success, adoption, retention or customer satisfaction.

  • Lead complex discovery and design efforts through ambiguity by synthesizing inputs, framing decisions and helping teams move with clarity.

How You Work

  • You raise the bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality across the teams around you.

  • You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking and hands-on design execution.

  • You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer.

  • You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people.

  • You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates.

  • You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum.

  • You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical design.

jobs.title: Mechanical Supervisor
jobs.description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challenge and the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The TE systems are part of the scope of the Marine team as temporary measures to facilitate the immersion of the elements. In total, 79 standard (220m long, 9m high, 45m wide) and 10 special elements (38m long, 12,5m high, 50m wide) will connect the Femern Belt Tunnel to both Germany and Denmark.

To be able to float up, transport and immerse the Tunnel Elements, the elements require temporary installations. These installations ensure that the elements float, stay balanced, immerse and can connect to the preceding element. A team of mechanics and electricians will install and test these installations.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

Execute the TE systems works whilst coordinating closely and effectively with the involved (internal) stakeholders to optimize efficiency.

Plan, execute and register maintenance & repairs to the TE systems equipment:

o Pumps / Piping / Valves

o Electrical components

o Subsea sensors

o Hydraulic cylinders / Powerpacks / manifolds

o Umbilical winches / Sliprings

o Rolling equipment

Thereby ensuring operational equipment in compliance with legislative-, safety- and user requirements.

You will lead the team of technicians installing, maintaining and repairing the Tunnel Elements systems during the preparation, transport and installation phase of Tunnel Elements. Understand the functionality of the Tunnel Element systems. Troubleshoot system during installation and operation. Maintain and organize the work area (workshop and yard facilities) to ensure an orderly and safe workplace in compliance with Danish regulation, company procedures, and good work practice. Set up, select and support the TE systems team of technicians to ensure effective and reliable production cycle.

In the role of the Mechanical Supervisor, there will be interface with subcontractors, Operational departments of various disciplines and operations staff.

Qualifications:

The TE systems Mechanical Supervisor:

- Has the ability to read and understand technical drawings, working methods and working procedures.

- Plans the work ahead.

- Manages daily interface with other TE outfitting parties.

- Communicates in English (minimum B2 level) both written and spoken.

- Optimizes the usage of the TE systems team capabilities.

- Supports and coaches the TE systems technicians.

- Has excellent interpersonal skills

- Organizes daily toolbox / pre-start meetings.

- Connects the tasks to the bigger picture.

- Provides support and input on risk assessments for TE mobilization / demobilization, general tasks.

Conditions: 

FLC considers transparent management structures, short decision-making channels, and a team-oriented environment to be extremely important. The FLC staff is expected to set themselves targets, achieve them independently, and take responsibility for their actions – irrespective of their position in the company. 

FLC offers attractive employment conditions on a Danish contract according to The Danish Salaried Employees Act (Funktionærloven). Pension health insurance and lunch arrangement will be available. 

Workplace:

Rødbyhavn Denmark

Application:

We look forward to receiving your application (in English) as soon as possible. Applications received will be processed on an ongoing basis, and we will complete the recruitment once we have found the right profile.

Contact:

For questions related to the position, please contact tri@flc-jv.com, lge@flc-jv.com
